cells.location: At *Hebbalaguppe* (Heggadadevankote hobli), on a vira-gal near the Râmeśvara temple.
cells.remarks: In the year. . . . . the 18th of the reign of Kulôttuṇga-Chōla-Dēva,—Alagiya-Chōla of Pervva- yalu, the nād-gāvuṇḍa of Navile-nād, when his son Navalashi-Rāja died, and his young wife Tapare Kammāri leaped (into the flames) and died, made for them a grant for a flower garden, of 100 ghaṭṭas of land in Kādamman-ere and 10 koḷaga of dry and wet land in Kongunigere.

cells.location: At the same village, on a stone in front of the Basava temple.
cells.remarks: While Nitimārgga Kongunivarmma dharma-mahārājādhirāja, boon lord of the city of Kovalāla, lord of Nandagiri, śrimat Permmānaḍi (was ruling the kingdom of the world) ; and the ornament of the Gaṅga family renowned in all lands, the head-jewel of princes, the abode of fortune, his powerful arm a pillar to bind the female elephant the goddess of Victory to, a treasury of all learning, śrimad Erepperasa was ruling over Nugu-nād and Navile-nād,—on the day that there was a fight in Bayal- nād, when Bayal-nād coming, attacked Kottamaṅgala, and seizing the cows, were going off, and Koṅ- guni of Pervvayalu hastening to the combat, fought in Bayal-nād and released the cows,—Rāma, son of Permmānaḍi-Gāmuṇḍa, fought with a man of Bayal-nād, and died. On which, Permmānaḍi and Ereyappa, halting together, gave to Permmānaḍi-Gāvuṇḍa and to Koṅguni of Pervvayalu and Kuru- mendūr, the chiefship of the nād and the kaḷnād of Kiruvūsuvūr. (After usual imprecation), Whoso ruins this kaḷnād, let him understand that he troubles the family of the rulers of Koṅgu and of Koḍugūr.
cells.text_roman: Svasti Nîtimargga Koṅgunivarmma dharmma-mahârâjâdhirâjan Kovalâla-pura-varēśvaran Nandigiri-nâthaṁ śrimat-Permmanadi-gal svasti samasta-bhuvanâ-praṇuta Gaṅga-kula-tilaka râjanya-chûḍâ-maṇi lakshmi-nivâsa vijaya-sri-karini-stambhayamâna-dorḍaṇḍa sakala-vidyâ-nidhi śrimad-Erepperasar Nugu-nâḍu Navale-nâḍuman aluttam ire Bayal-nâḍanol vigraham ada divasam Bayal-nâdam bandu Kottamaṁgalaman iridu turuvam koṇḍu pogutt ire Pervvayala Koṅguni puyyal varidu Bayal-nâdiṇul kâdi turuvam ikkisi Bayal-nâdanau ode kâdi Permmaṇadi-Gauṁdaṇana magâṁ Râmaṁ alli sattode Permmanadiyum Ereyapponum odan ildu Pervvayala Kurmmeṇḍura Permmanadi-Gauṁdaiṁgam Koṅgunigam nâḍa-nâl-gamuṁdum Kiruvusu-vârumani kalnadu goḷar behmani koṁdaṅge Vârâsiyum sâsira-kavileyum sâsirvva-parvvaruṁ sâsira-kereyuvan alida paṁcha-mâpatakan akkum i-kaḷnâḍan alidode Koṅgalara Kodugurara baṁcham attante aruge

ಕರರಾಜನ್ಯನಿರ್ಮಾಣಮಾಲಿಕೇಷ್ಠ ಶ್ರೀನಿವಾಸವಿಜಯತ್ರೈಲೋಕ್ಯಶ್ರೀಸೋಭ
**ಯುವಮನದೋದ್ದ ೯ಣೀಸಕಳವಿದ್ಯಾನಿಧಿತ್ರಿಮಭಚು ಜ್ಜೇಷ್ಠ ರಸಿನಗು
ನಾಪನುನೆಲನೆಳುವವನಾಳಂತ ಮಿರಬಲಯುಳ್ಳದೊಗ್ಗ ಗ್ಗ ನಮೌದ
**ವಿನಸಬಲಯುಳ್ಳ ದಂಬುಸ್ಟ ಕೋತ್ರ ಮುಳ್ಳ ಲಪನಿಸಿರುದಕುಸುಮವೆಂಕೋ
**ಟುಲು ಪ್ರೇಲಗುತಿ ರೇದೆವ್ಯಾಮಯುಳೊಬೊ ನಿಪ್ರುಯಲ್ಲುದುಚುಬಲ್ಲು ದನುಚ್ಯಾದಿ
**ತುಲುವಿನಿಕಿ ಸಬಲಯುಳ್ಳ ದನಯೋಡಿಕೆ ಕಾಜೀಮವಗ್ನಾಣಿಗಾಮುವ ನಾಮಗಂ
ರಾಮವನ್ನಿನತತ್ತ್ವ ಜಪೀವತ್ಕಾಂತಿಯಮವೆಜಿಯುವೆಸ್ಸು ನುವೆಣೇಶಿತ್ಯಾವೆ
**ವ್ಯ್ಯಾಉಲ್ಯುಕುಯುಮಸ್ತೃ ರವ್ಯಸ್ಥಾ ರ ಸದಿನಗಮಾಮಜ ಬ೧ ಒಕೊಟು ಲಿಗನ್ನ ದಣಾ
**ಅಣ ಮುಉನು ಕಿಜ್ಜವ್ರಸುವುರುಮಂಚಳನ್ಯ ದುಗ್ಗೋಟ್ಯಿದಿಶ್ಯ್ವ ಸಿಕೊಕುದಜೇ ವಾ
**ರಗಪಿಯಯೋಸಂಸಿರೇವಿತವಿಯೆಯಸುಮಪಿವ್ಯ್ಯಾಪೃ ವಾರಂಸಾಸಿ
**ರಕತುಯುವಾವೇನಾಜೀವಪಲ್ಲಾದ್ಯ ಮೂರ್ಖತಕಲು ಮುಕ್ಕಾಲ್ಯ ಧನಚು
**ದೇಪೂಜೋಕ್ಷ್ಯಾರ್ಗ ರಕೇರಹಣಿಗೊರಬಬಿದ್ವಾ ಮಸ್ಟ ನೇ ಅಜಂಗೆ

text.location: At the same village, on a stone in front of the Basava temple.
text.remarks:
While Nitimārgga Kongunivarmma dharma-mahārājādhirāja, boon lord of the city of Kovalāla,
lord of Nandagiri, śrimat Permmānaḍi (was ruling the kingdom of the world) ; and the ornament of the
Gaṅga family renowned in all lands, the head-jewel of princes, the abode of fortune, his powerful arm
a pillar to bind the female elephant the goddess of Victory to, a treasury of all learning, śrimad
Erepperasa was ruling over Nugu-nād and Navile-nād,—on the day that there was a fight in Bayal-
nād, when Bayal-nād coming, attacked Kottamaṅgala, and seizing the cows, were going off, and Koṅ-
guni of Pervvayalu hastening to the combat, fought in Bayal-nād and released the cows,—Rāma, son
of Permmānaḍi-Gāmuṇḍa, fought with a man of Bayal-nād, and died. On which, Permmānaḍi and
Ereyappa, halting together, gave to Permmānaḍi-Gāvuṇḍa and to Koṅguni of Pervvayalu and Kuru-
mendūr, the chiefship of the nād and the kaḷnād of Kiruvūsuvūr. (After usual imprecation), Whoso ruins
this kaḷnād, let him understand that he troubles the family of the rulers of Koṅgu and of Koḍugūr.Read more (1 KB)
text.text_roman: Svasti Nîtimargga Koṅgunivarmma dharmma-mahârâjâdhirâjan Kovalâla-pura-varēśvaran Nandigiri-nâthaṁ śrimat-Permmanadi-gal svasti samasta-bhuvanâ-praṇuta Gaṅga-kula-tilaka râjanya-chûḍâ-maṇi lakshmi-nivâsa vijaya-sri-karini-stambhayamâna-dorḍaṇḍa sakala-vidyâ-nidhi śrimad-Erepperasar Nugu-nâḍu Navale-nâḍuman aluttam ire Bayal-nâḍanol vigraham ada divasam Bayal-nâdam bandu Kottamaṁgalaman iridu turuvam koṇḍu pogutt ire Pervvayala Koṅguni puyyal varidu Bayal-nâdiṇul kâdi turuvam ikkisi Bayal-nâdanau ode kâdi Permmaṇadi-Gauṁdaṇana magâṁ Râmaṁ alli sattode Permmanadiyum Ereyapponum odan ildu Pervvayala Kurmmeṇḍura Permmanadi-Gauṁdaiṁgam Koṅgunigam nâḍa-nâl-gamuṁdum Kiruvusu-vârumani kalnadu goḷar behmani koṁdaṅge Vârâsiyum sâsira-kavileyum sâsirvva-parvvaruṁ sâsira-kereyuvan alida paṁcha-mâpatakan akkum i-kaḷnâḍan alidode Koṅgalara Kodugurara baṁcham attante aruge
text.text_original: ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಸವನ ಗುಡಿಯ ಮುಂದೆ ನೆಟ್ಟ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.ಪೂರ್ವಾದ ಹಳಗನ್ನಡ ದಕ್ಷರ. — ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 4'× 3'.ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ನೀತಿಮಾರ್ಗ್ಗ ರಕ್ಷೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿವ್ಯತ್ಯಸ್ತ್ರಾಮರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜಕೋಮಲಾಪರಪವಿತ್ರಾಧರಿಣಿಗಿನಾಫಣಕ್ರೀಮುಕ್ತಪರ್ಯ್ಯಾಣಿಕಶತ್ರುಸ್ಟ್ಯ ಸಮಸ್ತಭುವನಪ್ರಣತಗುಂಗುಲತಿಕರರಾಜನ್ಯನಿರ್ಮಾಣಮಾಲಿಕೇಷ್ಠ ಶ್ರೀನಿವಾಸವಿಜಯತ್ರೈಲೋಕ್ಯಶ್ರೀಸೋಭ**ಯುವಮನದೋದ್ದ ೯ಣೀಸಕಳವಿದ್ಯಾನಿಧಿತ್ರಿಮಭಚು ಜ್ಜೇಷ್ಠ ರಸಿನಗುನಾಪನುನೆಲನೆಳುವವನಾಳಂತ ಮಿರಬಲಯುಳ್ಳದೊಗ್ಗ ಗ್ಗ ನಮೌದ**ವಿನಸಬಲಯುಳ್ಳ ದಂಬುಸ್ಟ ಕೋತ್ರ ಮುಳ್ಳ ಲಪನಿಸಿರುದಕುಸುಮವೆಂಕೋ**ಟುಲು ಪ್ರೇಲಗುತಿ ರೇದೆವ್ಯಾಮಯುಳೊಬೊ ನಿಪ್ರುಯಲ್ಲುದುಚುಬಲ್ಲು ದನುಚ್ಯಾದಿ**ತುಲುವಿನಿಕಿ ಸಬಲಯುಳ್ಳ ದನಯೋಡಿಕೆ ಕಾಜೀಮವಗ್ನಾಣಿಗಾಮುವ ನಾಮಗಂರಾಮವನ್ನಿನತತ್ತ್ವ ಜಪೀವತ್ಕಾಂತಿಯಮವೆಜಿಯುವೆಸ್ಸು ನುವೆಣೇಶಿತ್ಯಾವೆ**ವ್ಯ್ಯಾಉಲ್ಯುಕುಯುಮಸ್ತೃ ರವ್ಯಸ್ಥಾ ರ ಸದಿನಗಮಾಮಜ ಬ೧ ಒಕೊಟು ಲಿಗನ್ನ ದಣಾ**ಅಣ ಮುಉನು ಕಿಜ್ಜವ್ರಸುವುರುಮಂಚಳನ್ಯ ದುಗ್ಗೋಟ್ಯಿದಿಶ್ಯ್ವ ಸಿಕೊಕುದಜೇ ವಾ**ರಗಪಿಯಯೋಸಂಸಿರೇವಿತವಿಯೆಯಸುಮಪಿವ್ಯ್ಯಾಪೃ ವಾರಂಸಾಸಿ**ರಕತುಯುವಾವೇನಾಜೀವಪಲ್ಲಾದ್ಯ ಮೂರ್ಖತಕಲು ಮುಕ್ಕಾಲ್ಯ ಧನಚು**ದೇಪೂಜೋಕ್ಷ್ಯಾರ್ಗ ರಕೇರಹಣಿಗೊರಬಬಿದ್ವಾ ಮಸ್ಟ ನೇ ಅಜಂಗೆ

cells.location: At *Aśikanathapura*, attached to *Hirihalli* (Heggadadevankote hobli), on a stone in front of the Arkēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: In the S'aka year 959, the year Īśvara, (&c), the 26th year of the reign of Mudigoṇḍa-Gaṅge- goṇḍa-Rājēndra-Chōla-Dēva ;—when the champion in ? mailed warfare, Chāṅgalya of Kuḍalūr in Noḷe- nād came forth on an expedition, Pḷiṅgeḍa-Gāvuṇḍa, Ajjhana-Gāvuṇḍa, his five sons, and others (named), obtained Nāgavaṅgalara as a kaḷnād, free of all imposts. Also (a number of persons named, ending with) Pañchava-mārāya, being pleased, bound the band of chiefship over Bhisern and the kaḷnād Nāgavaṅgala on Aṅka-Gāvuṇḍa and two other Gāvuṇḍas (named) . . . . (Imprecation).
cells.text_roman:
Svasti Shaka-varisham 959 neya Isvara-samvatsarada Âsada-mâssada kaj-ashtaveya Shati-naktra Somma-varada andu Sri-Mraudigonda-Gaugegonda-Rajhendra-Chola-Dēvarkki yaṁdu ippata-aravudu svasti sri-Nole-nâḍa Kuḍahira uigalaṅka-malla Chaugalva parivu paydaṇḍu Plingeda-gâvuṁdugal Kaligote-mallara tolxgada-gaṇḍara Ajjhana-Gavunilana makkal tammutta aiyvaru Muṁga-Gavuṁda Laka-Gavuṁdam Bhava-Gavuṁdi Ghava-Gavuṁdi Bhâsi-Gavuṁdich Keta-Gavuṁdi (hac) svasti Buva-Gavuṁda Bhasava-Gavuṁdanu . . sat padedam kaḷa-nattu Niu[l]gavaṁgaḷaui sarvvya-hariharam svasti śrimmat A Pervvayyala nnal-gavuṁdugaḷ Kurvanda Permmadi-Gauṁdam Echa-Gavuṁdaṁ Koṅguni-Gavuṁdam Utbaṁchhageya Kariyaramam Male-erina Bhicha-Gavuṁdi Pairageya Nacha-Gavunda Saivayashtiya-matn Bettula Rajhayya Koligala Gangaya Mmunuvyanaru maha-dânanayaka palar-mmeche-ganda Telgara . . Paṁchava-marâyaṁ mechchi Anka-Govuṁdage Palarmmeche-Gavuṁdaṁ Naduhhava-Ga[vu]n-daṁige Telugara Mari-Gavuṁdanol patan gati Bhiserum kaḷnath-Nâgavangaḷam abhrasiddi idanam pet ere-kondadu kereya Banarâsiya kavileyan alida Kâsi-liuga maṁgajaṁ ||

Heggadadevankote Taluq. 131

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಕಿರೀಪಳ್ಳೆಗೆ ಸೇರಿದ ಅಂಚನಾಥಪುರದ ಅರ್ಕೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಮುಂದೆ ನೆಟ್ಟ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
ಪೂರ್ವಾದ ಹಳಗನ್ನಡ ದಕ್ಷರ. — ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 4'× 4'.
ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಚಕವಿಸಶ ಕಳಿಗಾಸೆಯುಕ್ಕ ರದಪ್ರಸದ
**ಅನಪದವನಾಸ್ಪದಕಾಲತ್ತುಪೆಯುಪತಿನತ್ತ್ವ ಸಯೋವ್ಯ
**ಪರವರಲನ್ಮ ಕ್ರಮುಜ್ಯ ಊಗಂಣದ್ದ ರ್ಗ್ಯ ಗೆಗಣ್ಣ ರಾವೆಷ್ಟ ನ್ಯಜ್ಜೋ೯
**ಟಬದೇವರ್ಶ್ಯ ಯುನ್ನು ಇಸ್ಪ ತಲಜವಧುಸ್ತಪ್ಪಿ
**ಶ್ಲೋ ನೋಲಿನಕಡಕುಲುಸನಿಗೆಳಬ್ಭ ಮುಳ್ಳಜಂಗಲ್ಯ
**ಪುರಪದುನ್ನ ನ್ಸ ಡ್ತಿ ಸಿಜ್ಜೇ ವ್ ದಾಗಪ್ರುಟ್ಟು ಗಳ್ಳ ರೇಣೀಚೀಮಿಳ್ಳ ರ
**ತೊಲಪನಾಗಾ ರೇಲತ್ಸು ೧ ನಗಪ್ರುಟ್ಟು ನಮಕ್ಕ ೪ ಟ್ಟ ಮಯ್ಯ
**ಕೇ ಜಾಯ್ತುವರಮಂಗಣಪ್ರಣ್ಣ ಲಶಗಾಪುಣ್ಣು ಲಭಥವಾಪು
**ಣ್ಣು ಚಾವಾಗಪುಣ್ಣಾ ಧನಗಾಪುಣ್ಣಾ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಗಾಪುಣ್ಣಾ
ಹಿಂಭಾಗ,
**ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಟುನಗವುಣ್ಣಾ ಭಸನಾಗಾವೆಣ್ಣು ನು.
**ಸಪ್ಪ ಜೇವದಂಕಲ್ಲಾ ಟೃಪ್ಪನ್ನ ಗಾವಂಗಲಂಸನ್ಯು ಳಾಹಾರೆಂ
**ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಬ್ಬ ಷ್ಯಯೂಲ್ಯ ಣ್ಣಾ ತ್ಲಿ ವುಣ್ಣು ಗಳ್ಯ ನ್ನ
**ಕೇಮ್ಮಾಣಿಗಿ ವೃಣಾ ಇಮಿಕಾಗಾವುಣ್ಣೆ ನೆಣ್ಣು ಒಂಬುಗಿಣಪುಣ್ಣು ನು
**ಪ್ಪ ಣ್ಣೊ ೩ ಗೋಯಿಕರಿಯಮುಕ್ರಾಮವಲೃವಿಜಿನಭೀತಗಾಪುಣ್ಣಿ ವುಗ್ಗಿಗೆ
**ಜೇವಾಪುಣ್ಣಾ ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ವುದಮೃಷ್ಯಯುಮಂಪುಟ್ಟೂ ಇಲಾರಉಯುಕ್ಕೊ ಲೂಯಿ
ಗಾಲಗಂಗಯ
**ಮುಮ್ಮು ನುವುಣ್ಣಾರುಮಹಾವೆದನ್ಯಾಯುಕವಪಲ್ಮ ಣ್ಣಾ ಗಣೇಗಂಡಿ ತೇಲ್ಯ ರ
ಗಾ ಲ ಗ ೧ ಗ ಯ
**ಪಳ್ಳಾ ವಮವದುಮನ್ನ ಟ್ಟೇ ಆಕಗಳ್ತ ಪುಣ್ಣಾ ಗೇವಲಮ್ಮಣೇ ಕಾಗಾವಣ್ಣಾ
**ನುದುಭುವನಾ೯ ಪ್ರ್ಯ ಣ್ಣಾ ಯೋಗೇಲುರಮಾಗಾವಣ್ಣಾ ನೊಳ್ಳ ತುಬ್ನ ಟಿನಿ
**ಸರುಂಲಕ್ಕ ಣ ರಾಲ್ಯ ಗಾವಗೇಲಲಭಸಿನಿಧಿ ದವನಮತೇ ಜೀಕೊಣ್ಮ ಡು
**ಕೇಮಣಿ ವಯುಣ್ಣಾ ರಾಸಿಯುಕವಲಿಲೆಥನುಣೋ ಜಕಾತಿಲಿಂಗಂ
**ಮಂಗಲಂ

cells.location: *At Jinnahalli, (Jinnahalli hobli), on a virakal in Timmē-Gauḍa's field.*
cells.remarks: In the 7th year from the coronation of Konguṇivarmma dharmmahahārājādhirāja, boon lord of the city of Kōvala, lord of Nandagiri, srimat Satyavākya-Permmānaḍi ;—Māchiga, son of the righteous Ereyangappa, the foundation-pillar of the Ganga race, the master of the family of the Gaṅgas, worthy of the crown of Mādivarmma—under the orders of Guttiya-Ganga, fought against the king Nolambādhirāja in the war of Turundavolal, and died.
cells.text_roman:

gara vaṁśādhipati Madivarmma-vattakk arhan appa saypaṇta Ereyangappana magam Māchigam

cells.remarks: A grant by Gōpinātha, son of the king of the south, Bireya-daṇṇāyaka, to his guru. (After the date, given in a peculiar way and with most minute particulars), to the pratāpa-chakravartti, the son of Nallāṇu-Chakravartti, possessed of all titles,—the S'iva-arasu who by rectitude, virtue, r expansion and service was a Vaḍer, to Vēdha-Chakravartti,—Gōpinātha, the son of the sub- duer of Nilagiri, Bileya-daṇṇāyaka, doing obeisance to him, made a grant rent-free of Edatore in Kāneyala-sthala, with all the rights pertaining thereto, giving it as an agrahāra named Gōpinātha- pura, to continue as long as sun and moon endure, so that there should be no debt upon it.

text.location: *At Hemmaragaḷi (Jinnahalli hobli), on a stone in the Gaṇagalemarada-hola to the south of Voddara-pālya.*
text.remarks:
A grant by Gōpinātha, son of the king of the south, Bireya-daṇṇāyaka, to his guru. (After the date,
given in a peculiar way and with most minute particulars), to the pratāpa-chakravartti, the son of
Nallāṇu-Chakravartti, possessed of all titles,—the S'iva-arasu who by rectitude, virtue, r expansion
and service was a Vaḍer, to Vēdha-Chakravartti,—Gōpinātha, the son of the sub-
duer of Nilagiri, Bileya-daṇṇāyaka, doing obeisance to him, made a grant rent-free of Edatore in
Kāneyala-sthala, with all the rights pertaining thereto, giving it as an agrahāra named Gōpinātha-
pura, to continue as long as sun and moon endure, so that there should be no debt upon it.Read more (1 KB)

cells.remarks: Om. Be it well. Fortune wedded to his sceptre ; going along with his elder brother, having set up a pillar of victory in Kollapura ; having, in Koppa on the Pērār (river), . . . . . . Āhavamalla, and seized his elephants, horses, women and treasury ; having performed a victorious coronation, and taken his seat on an heroic throne ; the Kōv-irājakēsarivarmma, the Oḍeya Rājēndra-Dēva,—it being the 12th year of his reign,—(in) Kōligāl of Nevile-nāḍ in the MudikondaChōla-maṇḍala, in the S'aka year 984, the year Subhakrit (&c) :—Nāganna of Kereyūr, fearing the jealousy of Gaṅgaya, lord of the nāḍ, submitted to him ; when Saracha-Gāvuṇḍa, son of Gaṅgaya, saying ‘we cannot bear Nāganna’, [. . . . . .] Heggadadevankote Taluq. 81 Racha-Gouda, son of Ganga-Gonda of the Iladaga family, caused the stone to be erected. And Racha-Cavunda, son of Sanga-Gavunda of Koligala, a sun among the champions of the nad, Chola- Gamunda, bought with money and gave land to Ketachari (for it). Footnote 1. The meaning of this part is doubtful, owing to the inscription being much worn.

cells.location: At Hînanandi (Jinnahalli hobli), on a stone lying in front of the Sômēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Be it well.—When śrī-Ereyappa, the glory of . . . , ascended to svarga ; and Bhuvanāditya came saying that . . . . Kongani, the younger Rāchamalla, would give up to him, in the Manne (royal) residence, half the country and the treasury,-(and when) on his coming, the five sâmantas and the perggades said ' We do not wish any other than Rāchamalla to rule over the kingdom of Bayal-nâd', and Bhuvanāytana fought with them in Mâguṇdi,—the four sons of Korantiyarasa of Nindi fought as if for the destruction of the world and died. Kaligerayya caused this stone to be set up. The eldest son was . . . . Râma. (Imprecation). Bīrayya wrote this. (Mutilated verse in praise of their bravery).

cells.remarks: Obeisance to Ganadhipati. Praise of Sarasvati and S'ambhu. While the rājâdhiraja raja-para- mésvara vira-pratapa Deva-Râja-Vaḍerāyya of Maisûr, seated on the throne of S'rirangapattana, was ruling the kingdom of the world:—Kanthiravarasa, son of Deva-Raja-Voḍeyar and grandson of Deva- Raja-Voḍeyar of Maisur, of the Ātreya-gotra, Āśvalāyana-sūtra and Ṛik-śākhā, made to Betappayya, son of Raghupatayya and grandson of Gaurappayya of Kātûr, of the Gautama-gotra, Āpastamba-sūtra and Yajus-śākhā, a grant of the village of Bilugumba in Koṭṭagāla, giving it another name of Kanthi- ravapura. (Its boundaries). The said village have we given at the meritorious time of the (anniversary) day of our father('s death), in order that our father may be saved from re-birth and obtain a perma- nent abode in Vaikuntha. (The grant is repeated three times). And by consent of ourselves, our wives, sons, relatives, heirs and chiefs, this village of Kanthiravapura, with the right to mortgage, sell, give away, or exchange, may you, your sons, grandsons and descendants enjoy as long as sun and moon endure. (Usual final verses) (signed) śrī-Deva-Rāja.

cells.location: At Kyâtanahalli (Jinnahalli hobli), on the base of the pillar of the ranga-mantapa of the Lakshmîkânta temple.
cells.remarks: In the S'aka year 1086, the year Dundubhi,[Footnote 1] when Kovara-Kēta-Gonda of Tagadûr came and was carrying on the government, he made Kētanahalli, and built there the temple of the god Mallinātha, together with the new tank. His son Hoysala-Gavunda also had this maṇtapa, together with the god Lakshmī-Nārana, made. But as they had not been set up,—in the year 159, the year Dundubhi,[Footnote 1] 82 Heggadadêvankôte Taluq. Ampa, the son of Chôla-Dêva, and several others (named), uniting with all the chiefs and people, had this temple dedicated to the god with pouring of water, and to provide for carrying on the ceremonies, made a grant of land ...... Footnote 1. The name of the year does not correspond with either of the dates given, but 1159 = Durmukhi.

cells.location: At bēchârakh Dodda-Kereyûru (Jinnahalli hobli), on a stone in front of the Mâri temple.
cells.remarks: The fund established by Tipparasa for the god Chandranâtha of Kereyûr was as follows : — Whereas ... ... , son of Harahoppo-Malla, formerly made a grant for the lamp of the god ... ... ... , — having begged ...... la-Dêva, he took possession of that, and in exchange for it gave certain taxes (specified), to provide for the lamp of Mâdêva.

ga 6½ nû dêvara divigeya dharmmakke koṭṭev âgiyidanu (*usual imprecatory phrases*)

the Veṅkaṭramaṇa temple.

cells.text_roman:
Sītā-Rāma prasanna
Harēr līlā-varāhasya damṣṭra-daṇḍas sa pātu naḥ |
Hēmādri-kalaśā yatra dhātrī chhatra-śriyam dadhau ||
purataḥ-prañjalim vandē Mārutiṃ tava kiṅkaram |

Lakṣmaṇaṃ chaṅgadaṃ vandē Śatrughnaṃ praṇamāmy aham |
Jāmbavantaṃ cha vāyavya-dalādiṣu yathā-kramaṃ ||

cells.location: At Koṇḍāḷu (Kiragōji hobli), on the base of the Sōmēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: While the mahā-maṇḍalēśvara, the capturer of Talekāḍu Koṅgu Naṅgali Kōḷāla Hānuṅgal and Banavāse, the strong-armed Vīra-Gaṅga Vishṇuvarddhana Hoysala-Dēva, Nārasiṅga-Dēva, was ruling the kingdom of the world, beginning from the Heḍḍore (the Kṛishṇa river) :—Haṛada-Gāvuṇḍa, son of Teṇadaṅkera Bōgeya-Sāvanta of Toṇḍeyahāḷa, with his five sons, constructed a tank and raised a temple, and endowed them with land (specified).

vāse-goṇḍa bhuja-bala Vīra-Gaṅga Viṣṇuvardhana-Hoysaḷa-Dēvaru Heḍḍorey-ādi āgi śrī-Narasiṅga-
Dēvaru pṛthvī-rājyaṃ geyyuttam ire Śaka-varuṣa 1089 nēya Sarvajitu-saṃvatsarada Chaitra-śuddha-
pañchami-Bṛhavārada andu Toṇḍeyahāḷa Tenadaṅkara Bōgeya-Sāvantana maga Harada-Gāvuṇḍanu
Kāleya-Sāvantanu Dēka-Gāvuṇḍan-oḍa-vuṭṭida tamutt-ayvara makkalu kaṭṭisida kere ettisida dēvā-
layakke gadde khaṃ 4 ondu bēli beḍḍaleyu tri-bhāga saktige saluvant āgi biṭṭa daṭṭi ||

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಕೊಂಡಾಳಳು ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಸೋಮೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ತಳಪಾದಿಯ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ,
^1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಮತುಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯಚಕ್ರವರ್ತಿಭುವನಮಲ್ಲತಳಕಂಚೂರಗೊಂಡಗೊಳು ಜುಭುವಿಕವಿರ
^2ಗಂಗವಿದ್ಯು ವದ್ಧನರಾಜೊಯುಲದೇವರಹಡೇದ್ಯಾ ಜಿಯಾನಿವಿಯಗಿನೀಗುಮಾರಸಿಂಗವೇವರವ್ಯಪ್ಪುವಿಲಾಸಣ್ಯಮುತ್ತೈಮಿರೇನಕವ
^3ರುಷ ೧೦೪೯ ನೇಯುಸವರಚೆಜಿತಗಂವಸ್ತವರದಕೈತಸಸುದಂ ವೋಚೆಷಮಿಪ್ರವರದಂದುತ ರೋಜೆಯುವಾಹಳಕ ತೇನಡೇಕರಜೆ ಗೇಯುಸಾ
^4 ವೆಂಕರಮನಗನಹವವ್ರುಂದನಕಳ ಯಸುವಾನಂತಗಂಪ್ರದಂಚದಪುತ್ರಮಮುತ ಯೆಪ್ಪುರಮತ್ತುಕಳಕಟ್ಟಿಪಿಸಿದಕೇತಿ ಸಿವನದೇ
^5ವಾಲ್ಮಕ್ಕೇ ಗದ್ದೆ ಸಿಂ 8 ಜೇದ್ದ ಲಿಯುತ್ರಿಭುಗನಗತಿ ಗನಲು ವನತಬಾಳಜಿತದತ್ತೇ.

cells.location: At *Makanahalli* (Kiragōji hobli), on the door frame of the Narasimha temple, west of the village.
cells.remarks: Kṛishṇa Rāja-Vaḍeyar's work of merit. 10-11 Date ? 1020 A.D. In the 9th year of the reign of Rājēndra-Chōḷa-Dēva,—when Barama-Gāvuṇḍa, son of .... lā-Gāvuṇḍa of Maravūr in Te .... nāḍ (fell upon) Rājēndra-Chōḷa-Seṭṭi of that nāḍ, and the Rāma firm in fight, the champion in border warfare, swift in movement, Rājēndra-Chōḷa-Seṭṭi died,—Hulimadda, son of Alashabandhi, Rājēndra-Chōḷa's chief of the nāḍ, put to death Maḍḍayya who had lightly slain Chōḷa-Chetti, and seized his place : and Keleyabbe, S'iri-Kavaṇṇa and Bōmaṇṇa gave the chief certain land (specified) ; and Chōḷa-Seṭṭi had this eight-sided stone engraved. (Imprecation) .... attacking Maravūr and being unable to take it, stole and drove off the cows ; when, pleased at the bravery of Ipa-Gōṇḍa in recovering the cows which had been imprisoned by Hikkava-Gāvuṇḍa, they gave him a koḍage (extent specified). And on Rājēndra-Chōḷa-Seṭṭi's departure (or death), his dog 84 Huṇsūr Taluk. having run away (and been taken by) Sōvi-Nāyaka of . . . . śūr, Rājēndra-Chōla's chief of the nāḍ entered into his residence, drew out (the dog), burnt (the place), and seizing his 50 golden images, brought and gave them to his ruler^1 Footnote 1. The reference is probably to the arrangement set forth in the following verse, used in the worship of Rāma :— vāmē Bhūmisutā puras tu Hanumān pas'chāt sumitrā-sutas S'atrughnō Bharatas' cha pārśva-yugaḷē vāyvādi-kōṇēshu cha | Sugrīvas' cha Vibhīshaṇas' cha yuvarāṭ Tārā-sutō Jāmbavān madhyē nīla-sarōja-kōmala-rucim Rāmam bhajē s'yāmalam ||

cells.location: At *Periyapaṭṇa* (Periyapaṭṇa hobli), on the door-frame of the Channigārāya temple.
cells.remarks: The mahā-maṇḍalika-maṇḍalēśvara Kulōttuṅga-Chaṅgālva Piriya-Rājaiya-Dēva, son of S'īkaṇṭha- Rājaiya of the Sōmavaṁśa Rik-śākhā and Hārīta-gōtra, caused this town to be rebuilt, and gave it the name of Piriyarājapaṭṭana after himself. From this time forth the king of my own line or the king of any other line, or any one of the 101 families in the 18 castes, who calls it Piriyarājapaṭṭana is a (legitimate) son born to one father and one mother. Whoever calls it Siṅgapattana is guilty of killing his father and mother . . . . . . . .

cells.remarks: Confirmed.^2—Victorious, with his two feet surrounded by the jewelled crowns of gods and demons, the ascetic's rod and bowl in his hands, seated on the lotus, is Brahmā. Be it well.—Of vijaya-Vaijayanti,^3 purified by meditation on Svāmi-Mahāsēna and the group of mothers,^4 of the Mānavya-gōtra, a son of Hārīti, fully versed in the views he had adopted on the sacred writings,^5 the dharmma-mahārāja of the Kadambas, śri vijaya-S'īvamrigēsavarmma,—in the seventh year (of his reign), the tenth (day) of the bright fortnight of the month Mārggaśira, at the time thus set forth,—a body of wide and various merit acquired during many ages; of wealth and fame won by the valour of the strength of his own arm in many great and arduous wars; devoted to well protecting Hunsur Taluq. his subjects ; a friend of all things living ; given to honouring gods, Brahmans, priests and the learned ; ever making gifts to chief Brahmans of many thousands of cows, new lands ? with water, villages exempt from the sixth (or king's share), gifts of gold, food and many other kinds ; a Yudhishṭhira in justice ; a Pratarddana in truthful speech ; a Vishṇu in spirituality ; śri-vijaya-Ś'ivamṛigeśavaramahādharṁmma-mahārāja—gave to Sarvvasvāmi, son of Piṅgalasvāmi, an Ātharvvani Brahman, of the Aupagahanisa-gotra, learned in the veda and vedāṅga,—the Kiṟuñjilli village, with pouring of water and a gift (of a coin), as a Brahman endowment, exempt from the entry of troops, from *antashkaraṁ* and forced labour, and freed from *paṅgōlkōtom*.[1] Whoso maintains this, he will be the possessor of merit. Moreover, as to this, there is the verse spoken by Bhīshma :—Grants formerly made to Brahmans, by every effort maintain, O Yudhishṭhira, chief of the great ones of the earth : than giving, better is the maintaining another's gift.—This also is the verse spoken by Rāma :—Whatever grants were given by former kings for the sake of merit and fame, I also, from love of merit and kingly pride, desire to maintain.—This also :—Whoso resumes this is guilty of the five great sins.—It is said also :—The earth has been enjoyed by Sagara and many other kings ; whosesoever at any time was the land, his was then the fruit. Plates written by Kirttivara. Footnote 1. This inscription is very difficult to translate, and the meaning is rather doubtful in parts. 2. Siddhānta?—'The proper translation of this term is much disputed. It may mean either as above, or "accomplished," or "may it endure," or "obeisance to the Siddhas," &c. 3. i.e. Banavāsi. 4. The six mothers of Svāmi-Mahāsēna, the god of war,—identified with the Pleiades. 5. The exact signification of this difficult phrase, which occurs in a great many Kadamba inscriptions, is matter of conjecture.

ಪೇರಿಯಾಪಟ್ಟೆ ದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಹಿಟ್ಟೆ ಹೆಬ್ಬುಗೆಲ ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿದಾರ ನಂಜುಂಡಯ್ಯನ ಸೊಸೇ ಪಾರ್ವತಮ್ಮನನೆ
ವಶದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ ತಾಮ್ರಶಾಸನ.
ಪೂರ್ವದ ಹಳಗನ್ನಡಪ್ರಕರ—4 ಪುಟಗಳು—ಸಿಂಹದ ಮುದ್ರೆ.
ನೀನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಒಂದಾಗ,
^1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಮ || ಜಯತುಸುರಾಸುರಮಕುಟಸಂಘಟಿತಮಣಿಕಿರಣಾನಿಚೀತಚರಣಯುಗಃ
^2ದಣ್ಡ ಕರ್ಮ್ಮಣಾ ಉಭಪತ್ವಿಭದ್ರವಪ್ರರಾಸನಪ್ರಯಾ|| ^3 ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿವಿಜಯವೈಜ
^4ಯನ್ತಾ ಲ್ಯೋಮ್ಸ್ಯಾಮಿಯಮಯಿಸೇನವಾತ್ಯಗಗನಾದುದ್ಘಾತ್ರಾಭಿಷಿಕ್ತ್ ಸ್ವಮಾನಸ್ಯಾ
^5ಸಗೋತ್ರಪ್ರಸ್ದಸ್ತಾವಿಕೃತಿಪ್ರಸ್ತೃತಿಪ್ರತ್ಯತ್ಪಾತ್ಯಾ ಯುತ್ತಯಾಜ್ಯ್ವಾಪಾಸರಸ್ಯ
2ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಮುಂಭಾಗ,
^6ಕಾದಚ್ಛವ್ವಾ ಸ್ನಾಮಿನಮ್ನಮಹಾಬಾಣಾಸ್ಯಜೀವಿಜಯೋವಷ್ಟು ಗೆಕವವರ್ಮ್ಮಣಾ
^7ಸಂಪ್ವತ್ಸರೇಣೇಷ್ವ ಮೇಷವೇಣಾಸ್ಯ ಗಿರಿರವನಾನಕುಲ ಪಷ್ಪಶಕವಮ್ಯಾವನಯಾನಾ
^8ಪುಣ್ಯಾರ್ತ್ಥಾಣೇಕಜನ್ಮನ್ಯ ಲೋಣಸಾಜ್ಯ್‌ಚತವಿಪುಲವಿಷ್ಠತ್ಪ್ರಜ್ಞಾನೇಥ್ಯಃ
^9ಮಹಾತಿಸಮರಸಂಗಂಕಟಿಜ್ಞ ಭುಜಬಲಪರಾರ್ಕ್ಕ್ಯ/ನಾನಾಪವಿಶಾಲ
3ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಹಿಂಭಾಗ,
^10ವಿಭವಿಷ್ಯತ್ಯುದ್ಯಗಾಸವಮ್ಯಕ್ಯೋಣಪರಿಪಾಲನದಕ್ಷಸ್ಯಸರ್ವಜೀವತನೃತಿಃ
^11ದೇವಪ್ರಿ ಜಗಉರುಪವ್ಯ್ಜಿನ ಜನಾಭ್ಯಲೈಕನವರದದ್ವಿಜವರೇಭ್ಯಂಜಜಸ್ರ
^12ಮನೇಕರ್ಗೋಗೇಕಸನವನಕ್ಕೆತ್ರಪ್ರಲಷಣ್ಣಿ ವತ್ಥಣೇಗ್ರಾಮಮಹಿದಾರ್ಯ್ಯಾನ್ಮದಿ
^13ಸ್ವೇಕವಿಪದ್ವರಾನನಸ್ತೃೆಯಾವಧಿಷಿ ರ್ಣಭವಧಮ್ಮರ್ಜ್ಞ್ಞಜ್ಯಪದರ್ಧ್ಯಾನದ
4ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಮುಂಭಾಗ,
^14ಸತ್ಯವಾಚಿನವಿಷ್ಯರಿವಿಬಪ್ತ್ಯಗ್ನಿಶ್ರೀವಿಜಯವೊೆವಮ್ಯಗೋವಮ್ಯಧನ್ವತ್
^15ಮಹಾನಾರಾಜಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಾಅಳುಕವ್ಯರ್ಣಿಕಾಯವೊೆಬೆಹಪಹಿನಿಗೋ೯
^16ತ್ಥಾಯುವೆದೆವೇದಾಳಿ ವಿದೇಷಿಬಲ ಲಸತ್ವಿಪುತ್ರಾಯಸರ್ವಸ್ವಾಸ್ಪಿನೇ
^17ಟ್ಟುನಿಸರಿಲ್ಲಗ್ರಾಮದಮನಸಪಾವೆನಿಯಪಾತನಸದಕ್ಷಿಣಿಉಪಸ್ಥದೆಯು
4ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಹಿಂಭಾಗ,
^18ಸಮಯೇನಎಳಭಷಪ್ವಿವರಮನ್ನಸ್ಥ ರವಿಸ್ಮ್ಯ ಕವಸ್ಮಿಕೃತ
^19ಷಹೋಯತ್ತೋಮದತ್ತವಾನ್ವೋಯೆಸ್ವಾಭಿರಕ್ಷೆತಾಸತತ್ಯಕ್ವೋವಲಭೂ
^20ಗ್ನವತಿ || ^1ಅಖಿಲಾತಳನಿಷ್ಠಪ್ರಗಿತಕೀರ್ತಿಕೆ || ^2 ಪೂರ್ವದದಾತ್ಮಿಜ್ಯಾಳಿಭ್ಯೋ
^3ಯುತ್ತ್ಯಾ ದ್ರಷ್ಟಯಉಷ್ಯಿ ರಮ್ಯಮುಖೇತಉತಾಂಕೃತ್ಯಿಧಾನ್ಯಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಗ್ಯೋಣಸುಪಾಲನನು ||

text.remarks:
Confirmed.^2—Victorious, with his two feet surrounded by the jewelled crowns of gods and demons,
the ascetic's rod and bowl in his hands, seated on the lotus, is Brahmā.

Be it well.—Of vijaya-Vaijayanti,^3 purified by meditation on Svāmi-Mahāsēna and the group of
mothers,^4 of the Mānavya-gōtra, a son of Hārīti, fully versed in the views he had adopted on the sacred
writings,^5 the dharmma-mahārāja of the Kadambas, śri vijaya-S'īvamrigēsavarmma,—in the seventh
year (of his reign), the tenth (day) of the bright fortnight of the month Mārggaśira, at the time thus
set forth,—a body of wide and various merit acquired during many ages; of wealth and fame won
by the valour of the strength of his own arm in many great and arduous wars; devoted to well protecting

Hunsur Taluq.
his subjects ; a friend of all things living ; given to honouring gods, Brahmans, priests and the learned ;
ever making gifts to chief Brahmans of many thousands of cows, new lands ? with water, villages
exempt from the sixth (or king's share), gifts of gold, food and many other kinds ; a Yudhishṭhira in
justice ; a Pratarddana in truthful speech ; a Vishṇu in spirituality ; śri-vijaya-Ś'ivamṛigeśavaramahādharṁmma-mahārāja—gave to Sarvvasvāmi, son of Piṅgalasvāmi, an Ātharvvani Brahman, of the
Aupagahanisa-gotra, learned in the veda and vedāṅga,—the Kiṟuñjilli village, with pouring of water
and a gift (of a coin), as a Brahman endowment, exempt from the entry of troops, from *antashkaraṁ*
and forced labour, and freed from *paṅgōlkōtom*.[1]

Whoso maintains this, he will be the possessor of merit. Moreover, as to this, there is the verse
spoken by Bhīshma :—Grants formerly made to Brahmans, by every effort maintain, O Yudhishṭhira,
chief of the great ones of the earth : than giving, better is the maintaining another's gift.—This also
is the verse spoken by Rāma :—Whatever grants were given by former kings for the sake of merit
and fame, I also, from love of merit and kingly pride, desire to maintain.—This also :—Whoso
resumes this is guilty of the five great sins.—It is said also :—The earth has been enjoyed by Sagara
and many other kings ; whosesoever at any time was the land, his was then the fruit.

Plates written by Kirttivara.

3. i.e. Banavāsi.
4. The six mothers of Svāmi-Mahāsēna, the god of war,—identified with the Pleiades.

text.text_original: ಪೇರಿಯಾಪಟ್ಟೆ ದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಹಿಟ್ಟೆ ಹೆಬ್ಬುಗೆಲ ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿದಾರ ನಂಜುಂಡಯ್ಯನ ಸೊಸೇ ಪಾರ್ವತಮ್ಮನನೆವಶದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ ತಾಮ್ರಶಾಸನ.ಪೂರ್ವದ ಹಳಗನ್ನಡಪ್ರಕರ—4 ಪುಟಗಳು—ಸಿಂಹದ ಮುದ್ರೆ.ನೀನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಒಂದಾಗ,^1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಮ || ಜಯತುಸುರಾಸುರಮಕುಟಸಂಘಟಿತಮಣಿಕಿರಣಾನಿಚೀತಚರಣಯುಗಃ^2ದಣ್ಡ ಕರ್ಮ್ಮಣಾ ಉಭಪತ್ವಿಭದ್ರವಪ್ರರಾಸನಪ್ರಯಾ|| ^3 ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿವಿಜಯವೈಜ^4ಯನ್ತಾ ಲ್ಯೋಮ್ಸ್ಯಾಮಿಯಮಯಿಸೇನವಾತ್ಯಗಗನಾದುದ್ಘಾತ್ರಾಭಿಷಿಕ್ತ್ ಸ್ವಮಾನಸ್ಯಾ^5ಸಗೋತ್ರಪ್ರಸ್ದಸ್ತಾವಿಕೃತಿಪ್ರಸ್ತೃತಿಪ್ರತ್ಯತ್ಪಾತ್ಯಾ ಯುತ್ತಯಾಜ್ಯ್ವಾಪಾಸರಸ್ಯ2ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಮುಂಭಾಗ,^6ಕಾದಚ್ಛವ್ವಾ ಸ್ನಾಮಿನಮ್ನಮಹಾಬಾಣಾಸ್ಯಜೀವಿಜಯೋವಷ್ಟು ಗೆಕವವರ್ಮ್ಮಣಾ^7ಸಂಪ್ವತ್ಸರೇಣೇಷ್ವ ಮೇಷವೇಣಾಸ್ಯ ಗಿರಿರವನಾನಕುಲ ಪಷ್ಪಶಕವಮ್ಯಾವನಯಾನಾ^8ಪುಣ್ಯಾರ್ತ್ಥಾಣೇಕಜನ್ಮನ್ಯ ಲೋಣಸಾಜ್ಯ್‌ಚತವಿಪುಲವಿಷ್ಠತ್ಪ್ರಜ್ಞಾನೇಥ್ಯಃ^9ಮಹಾತಿಸಮರಸಂಗಂಕಟಿಜ್ಞ ಭುಜಬಲಪರಾರ್ಕ್ಕ್ಯ/ನಾನಾಪವಿಶಾಲ3ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಹಿಂಭಾಗ,^10ವಿಭವಿಷ್ಯತ್ಯುದ್ಯಗಾಸವಮ್ಯಕ್ಯೋಣಪರಿಪಾಲನದಕ್ಷಸ್ಯಸರ್ವಜೀವತನೃತಿಃ^11ದೇವಪ್ರಿ ಜಗಉರುಪವ್ಯ್ಜಿನ ಜನಾಭ್ಯಲೈಕನವರದದ್ವಿಜವರೇಭ್ಯಂಜಜಸ್ರ^12ಮನೇಕರ್ಗೋಗೇಕಸನವನಕ್ಕೆತ್ರಪ್ರಲಷಣ್ಣಿ ವತ್ಥಣೇಗ್ರಾಮಮಹಿದಾರ್ಯ್ಯಾನ್ಮದಿ^13ಸ್ವೇಕವಿಪದ್ವರಾನನಸ್ತೃೆಯಾವಧಿಷಿ ರ್ಣಭವಧಮ್ಮರ್ಜ್ಞ್ಞಜ್ಯಪದರ್ಧ್ಯಾನದ4ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಮುಂಭಾಗ,^14ಸತ್ಯವಾಚಿನವಿಷ್ಯರಿವಿಬಪ್ತ್ಯಗ್ನಿಶ್ರೀವಿಜಯವೊೆವಮ್ಯಗೋವಮ್ಯಧನ್ವತ್^15ಮಹಾನಾರಾಜಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಾಅಳುಕವ್ಯರ್ಣಿಕಾಯವೊೆಬೆಹಪಹಿನಿಗೋ೯^16ತ್ಥಾಯುವೆದೆವೇದಾಳಿ ವಿದೇಷಿಬಲ ಲಸತ್ವಿಪುತ್ರಾಯಸರ್ವಸ್ವಾಸ್ಪಿನೇ^17ಟ್ಟುನಿಸರಿಲ್ಲಗ್ರಾಮದಮನಸಪಾವೆನಿಯಪಾತನಸದಕ್ಷಿಣಿಉಪಸ್ಥದೆಯು4ನೇ ಪತ್ರದ ಹಿಂಭಾಗ,^18ಸಮಯೇನಎಳಭಷಪ್ವಿವರಮನ್ನಸ್ಥ ರವಿಸ್ಮ್ಯ ಕವಸ್ಮಿಕೃತ^19ಷಹೋಯತ್ತೋಮದತ್ತವಾನ್ವೋಯೆಸ್ವಾಭಿರಕ್ಷೆತಾಸತತ್ಯಕ್ವೋವಲಭೂ^20ಗ್ನವತಿ || ^1ಅಖಿಲಾತಳನಿಷ್ಠಪ್ರಗಿತಕೀರ್ತಿಕೆ || ^2 ಪೂರ್ವದದಾತ್ಮಿಜ್ಯಾಳಿಭ್ಯೋ^3ಯುತ್ತ್ಯಾ ದ್ರಷ್ಟಯಉಷ್ಯಿ ರಮ್ಯಮುಖೇತಉತಾಂಕೃತ್ಯಿಧಾನ್ಯಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಗ್ಯೋಣಸುಪಾಲನನು ||

cells.remarks: While, (with usual titles), the pratāpa-chakravartti, the Hoysaḷa strong-armed vira-Ballāḷa- Dēvarasa was in the capital of Dorasamudra, carrying on the kingdom of the world in peace and wisdom :—he granted, to Mādeya-Nāyka of Kōṭeyakuppe, Uyinabāḷu for the support of ten horses ; and to provide a rental of 1000 (pagodas) for that Mādeya-Nāyka, favoured him with 10 hamlets belonging to Kōṭeyakuppe in Kuppa-nād, to continue to his children's children. And having ordered him to join the great minister Battaḷasa-Daṇṇāyaka (in the expedition) to Pālpare, that Beṭṭarasa-Daṇṇāyaka, marching to Pālpare, ruined Chāṅgaḷva-Mahādēva, and building a city at Pālpare, made it his capital. Then Chāṅgaḷva-Pemma-Virappa, Bādaganda Nandi-Dēva, Udeyāditya-Dēva of Kuruche, and others, the Koḍagas (or Coorgs) of all the nāds, uniting, marched against Pālpare and fought with Beṭṭarasa-Daṇṇāyaka. In the battle which took place, the favourite of . . . . ., the . . . . . maṇḍalika, the champion of the brave, a bell of valour, Mādeya-Nāyka of Kōṭeyakuppe, in fighting with . . . . yanna and a man of Pālpare, Beṭṭarasa-Daṇṇāyaka being worsted, secured the fortune of victory, and amid a rain of flowers, surrounded by Apsara nymphs, went to the world of gods and gained a great name. And for that Mādeya-Nāyka's sons, Maḍappa and Mallappa, Beṭṭarasa-Daṇṇāyaka granted Hõnneyanahalli in . . . . nād and . . . . of Pālpare as a *nettari-koḍagi*.

text.remarks:
While, (with usual titles), the pratāpa-chakravartti, the Hoysaḷa strong-armed vira-Ballāḷa-
Dēvarasa was in the capital of Dorasamudra, carrying on the kingdom of the world in peace and
wisdom :—he granted, to Mādeya-Nāyka of Kōṭeyakuppe, Uyinabāḷu for the support of ten horses ;
and to provide a rental of 1000 (pagodas) for that Mādeya-Nāyka, favoured him with 10 hamlets
belonging to Kōṭeyakuppe in Kuppa-nād, to continue to his children's children.

And having ordered him to join the great minister Battaḷasa-Daṇṇāyaka (in the expedition) to
Pālpare, that Beṭṭarasa-Daṇṇāyaka, marching to Pālpare, ruined Chāṅgaḷva-Mahādēva, and building
a city at Pālpare, made it his capital. Then Chāṅgaḷva-Pemma-Virappa, Bādaganda Nandi-Dēva,
Udeyāditya-Dēva of Kuruche, and others, the Koḍagas (or Coorgs) of all the nāds, uniting, marched
against Pālpare and fought with Beṭṭarasa-Daṇṇāyaka. In the battle which took place, the favourite
of . . . . ., the . . . . . maṇḍalika, the champion of the brave, a bell of valour, Mādeya-Nāyka of
Kōṭeyakuppe, in fighting with . . . . yanna and a man of Pālpare, Beṭṭarasa-Daṇṇāyaka being worsted,
secured the fortune of victory, and amid a rain of flowers, surrounded by Apsara nymphs, went to the
world of gods and gained a great name.

And for that Mādeya-Nāyka's sons, Maḍappa and Mallappa, Beṭṭarasa-Daṇṇāyaka granted
Hõnneyanahalli in . . . . nād and . . . . of Pālpare as a *nettari-koḍagi*.Read more (1 KB)

ಈ ಪತ್ರದ ಮೂಲಭಾಗ.
1ಶುಭಮಸ್ತು | ನಮಸ್ತುಂಗಿರೇಕ್ಯು ಅಬಿತೇಂದ್ರ
2ಚಾಮಾರತಾರವೇ | ತೈ ತ್ರೈಲೋ
3ಕ್ಯ್ಕನಗರದಾರಂಭಮೂಲಸ್ಯ ಜಯಃಕಲಂಭವೇ ||
4ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನ
5ಶವರ್ಷ ೧೮೯೯ ವರ್ತಮಾನಸಲುವಪ್ರಧನ
6ಸಂವತ್ಸರದೆವತಾಪಕುದ್ಧ್ಯು ಣಲಪಾಠಕ
7ಗೋರ್ತ್ರನರಕಳ್ಳುಯುವನನತ್ರದ್ರುಂದಕಣಿತ್
8ಯುತ್ರಿವನ್ನಸ್ತಮಮಂಡಲೀಕಮಂಡಲೇಶ್ರ್ವರ
9ಕಾಲೂತ್ರತ್ರುಂಗುಮುದುವಂಸೊತ್ಕವರಹಾಬಿರರಾಜ
10ರಾಜದರವೆಕೇಶ್ವರಕಿಣೀಪತಾಪಚಕ್ರಂ
11ಶರ್ಮವಮಾಹಾರುಸಂಗಳಕತ್ಪಯಸರತಿ
12ವೀರವಿಜೇಲಶೆಪ್ರವಹಮಹಾಸಂಗಳುರಾಬಾದ್ಯ
13ಜುಗೋತ್ತ್ರದಕಳ್ಯಲವಯನಸುತ್ರ ದರುಗಾ
14ತೇಲಉಲ್ಪಾನ್ಯದಿನಿಸೀಮೂಪಾನಪರಿತ್ರಿತಕ್ರಮ
15ತ್ಯ್ಕಳನಾರಸಿಂಹಭಟ್ಟರಿಗೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟ ತಾಮ್ರಷಾಸನ
16ವ್ಯಕ್ತಮವೆಂತೆಂದರನವ್ಯಸಿಂಗಪಟ್ಟದ ಲವೆವೀರಾಂಕು
17ದ್ರಿಯಾಥನುನೀಗಗೆಹಾವವಾಹನ್ಸೂರಮಗ್ಗಹಣ
18ಪಪ್ರುಣ್ಯ್ಕಾಲದಲಿವಿರೇಶ್ವರನನಸ್ತಿ ನಿಮಲರಿಗೆ
19ವಷ್ಯ್ಕಪಜಮುವದುಲಿಸಿರೋಕ್ಯದಕಧಾಪಾವೂ
20ರ್ವಕಪತ್ರದ ಸಿಂಬಗ,
21ವರ್ಷವಾಗಿಕೊಟ್ಟಿ, ವಾಗಳವಿಚಾರೂಬಿಂದ್ಯಚತುಃ
22ಸೀಮಾಯವಿವರಣಿಕೆಬ್ಯಿನಪೂಜಾಲಿಂಗಮೋದಕ
23ಗೂಂಡಿಯೊಂದಬಣಿಗಲವಮರದಿಂದಪಟವಕ
24ಲವುನೋರಟೆಯೊಂದಕೆ ಕಣಿಕೀಜಟ್ಟಸುನ್ಯಾಸಿಯುಳ
25ಘಿನಿನಿಕ್ಷ್ರಪಜಲಮೂಪಣಅಕ್ಷಿ ಜಳಾಗ
26ವಿಸಿನಿದ್ಯ ನಹವ್ಯಗಳಂಬಲಪ್ಪೃಭೋಗತೇಜಜಸ್ಮ್ಯ
27ವ್ಯಮ್ಪನಉಲದೊಂದುಕಕಸಪ್ರೆಯೂಗಲಿಪುತ್ರಸಾತ್ರ)
28ಪರಂಪರೆಯಾಗಿಸುಬಲಳ್ಳೆಅನುಭವಿಸುಟು
29ಹಿರಿಯಂದುಪಹರಗೋತ್ರದತಕ್ಮಳಲಯನಸೂ
30ತ್ರನರುಕಾಲಕತಿಯುಯುವಕರೆದ್ರನ್ನಮನೃ
31ಹೊಮಮಂಡಲೀಕಮಂಡಲೇಶ್ವರಕಲೋತ್ರತ್ಯು ಂಗಕಂಗಾ
32ಲ್ಯ್ಕರಾಜಾಧಿರಾರಾಜಾಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಕಿಣೀಲ
33ಪ್ರತಾಸನರಾಜರಾಜನ್ಯಪಟ್ಟಿರಾಜೀವೇಕರ್ಲವೆನ
34ಮಹಾಅರಸುನರ್ಗಾಳವರಾರತಿಯ್ಕನಿಲವಿಲಿ
35ಕೇಲೇವಮಾಮಲಳಸಲಗುಳುಪಾಗೆಯೋಗಿಪ್ರೆತ್ರ
36ತಲ್ಪಲ್ಯ್ಯನಾಸೂತ್ರವರುಕಾಣತಳಿಯು
37ಅಪೂನ್ನದಾನಿಸೋಮವನಾಭನಿಕ್ಷಿತರಮ

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬೆಲಹಾಳು ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರಿಗುಡಿಯ ಬಳಿ ನೆಟ್ಟ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.

cells.location: At *Dodḍa-Belahāḻu* (Kagguṇḍi hobli), on a stone near the *Māri* temple.
cells.remarks: The mahā-maṇḍalika-maṇḍalēśvara Kulōttuṅga-Chāṅgāḷva—Whereas Aubhalēśvara-arasu of Nandivāla presented to Śrīkaṇṭha-Vodeyar of Nañjarāyapaṭṭana a palanquin, and as an umbali for the same, granted Belahāḷu and the land belonging to Belahāḷu,—we, of our own will, agree to the grant of the palanquin and of the lands assigned as umbali for it.

cells.location: At the *same village*, on a stone to the *south* of the *Īsvara* temple.
cells.remarks: Kēteya-Daṇṇāyka, son of the great minister Nāgiya-Daṇṇāyka, made to Rāghava-Dēva a grant of Belahāḷu, the eastern gate of Chāṅga-nāḍ, as a koḍagi, together with all the claims and rights (specified) pertaining thereto, making the grant with the full approval of his wife, sons, relations, chiefs and heirs, and of his own will, to continue as long as sun and moon endure. Any letter in defect or any letter in excess notwithstanding, this is confirmed. In approval of which, the writing of Sēnabōva Allappa. That Kēteya-Daṇṇāyka's own hand signature, Śrī-Allāḷanātha.

cells.location: At Beṭṭadapura (*Beṭṭadapura hobli*), on a stone in Paṭēļ Nandi-Baheṭṭi's back-yard.
cells.remarks: The maṇḍalēśvara Rāma-Rājaya's (son) Tirumala-Rājaya-Dēva-mahā-arasu gave to Rudra-Gāṇa of Nañjarāyapaṭṭaṇa a stone charter as follows :—Tirumala-Rājaya, son of Rāma-Rājaya, son of Tiru- mala-rāya, in order that merit might accrue to them (these three, again named), made a grant of the Malalavādi country for the service, decorations, festivals and offerings of the god Annadāni-Mallikār- juna ; and that they should not fail as long as the Nañjarāyapaṭṭaṇa kings of the Chāṅgālva family continued, as long as earth and sky continued, have we given and set up this stone charter. With petition to Kāśi, Kēdāra, Nīlakaṇṭha, Lēpākṣa, Tuṅgabhadra and Vārāṇasi, at the Aksha- tadige, in the sacred bathing place of Rāmānathapura ; with petition to the god Mallikārjuna of the S'riśaila mountain, with petition to the god Tiruvēṅgaḷanātha of Tirupati, with petition to the god Nañjuṇḍēśvara of the Kappini, with petition to the god Raṅganātha of S'rīraṅgapaṭṭaṇa, with petition to Kailāsa and Vaikuṇṭha, in the midst of the car-festival of the god Annadāni-Mallikārjuna, have we given and set up this charter. In order that merit may accrue to twenty-one former generations, namely ten fathers and eleven mothers, have we given (&c. repeating the grant). In similar terms the *paqu-li* tax paid by Rudra-Gāṇa to S'rīraṅgapaṭṭaṇa is remitted, and the government of the Malalavādi country, with that of the estates in the Nañjarāyapaṭṭaṇa kingdom belonging to the god Mallikārjuna, are confirmed to Rudra-Gāṇa, with the first name of P......... ........ of the Chāṅgālva family. Whoever of the kings, chiefs, officials, lords or leaders, that may in future be established in S'rī- raṅgapaṭṭaṇa, disregards this order, he is guilty of incest with the mother who bore him, of giving his honour to those that are nameless, and of plunging 21 generations of his mother's and fathers, without remedy or lineage, into the consequences of his wickedness. 88 Hunsûr Taluq. This grant (details repeated) is made in the presence of the one lakh and ninety-six thousand Jangama deities. The witnesses to this agreement are (the god) Silapiliraya of Melukote and the twelve Ålvār.

text.location: At Beṭṭadapura (*Beṭṭadapura hobli*), on a stone in Paṭēļ Nandi-Baheṭṭi's back-yard.
text.remarks:
The maṇḍalēśvara Rāma-Rājaya's (son) Tirumala-Rājaya-Dēva-mahā-arasu gave to Rudra-Gāṇa
of Nañjarāyapaṭṭaṇa a stone charter as follows :—Tirumala-Rājaya, son of Rāma-Rājaya, son of Tiru-
mala-rāya, in order that merit might accrue to them (these three, again named), made a grant of the
Malalavādi country for the service, decorations, festivals and offerings of the god Annadāni-Mallikār-
juna ; and that they should not fail as long as the Nañjarāyapaṭṭaṇa kings of the Chāṅgālva family
continued, as long as earth and sky continued, have we given and set up this stone charter.

With petition to Kāśi, Kēdāra, Nīlakaṇṭha, Lēpākṣa, Tuṅgabhadra and Vārāṇasi, at the Aksha-
tadige, in the sacred bathing place of Rāmānathapura ; with petition to the god Mallikārjuna of the
S'riśaila mountain, with petition to the god Tiruvēṅgaḷanātha of Tirupati, with petition to the god
Nañjuṇḍēśvara of the Kappini, with petition to the god Raṅganātha of S'rīraṅgapaṭṭaṇa, with petition
to Kailāsa and Vaikuṇṭha, in the midst of the car-festival of the god Annadāni-Mallikārjuna, have
we given and set up this charter. In order that merit may accrue to twenty-one former generations,
namely ten fathers and eleven mothers, have we given (&c. repeating the grant).

In similar terms the *paqu-li* tax paid by Rudra-Gāṇa to S'rīraṅgapaṭṭaṇa is remitted, and the
government of the Malalavādi country, with that of the estates in the Nañjarāyapaṭṭaṇa kingdom
belonging to the god Mallikārjuna, are confirmed to Rudra-Gāṇa, with the first name of P.........
........ of the Chāṅgālva family.

Whoever of the kings, chiefs, officials, lords or leaders, that may in future be established in S'rī-
raṅgapaṭṭaṇa, disregards this order, he is guilty of incest with the mother who bore him, of giving his
honour to those that are nameless, and of plunging 21 generations of his mother's and fathers, without
remedy or lineage, into the consequences of his wickedness.

88 Hunsûr Taluq.

This grant (details repeated) is made in the presence of the one lakh and ninety-six thousand
Jangama deities. The witnesses to this agreement are (the god) Silapiliraya of Melukote and the
twelve Ålvār.Read more (2 KB)

cells.location: *At the same village, on a stone in the temple on the Mallikârjuna-be|ta.*
cells.remarks: At the divine lotus feet of the great chief god, the god Annadāni-Mallikārjuna of S'igiri, Dāsari- Nāyka of Yiṭagaiyanūr made a grant of the village of Bāṅgaruvaḷi. And in memory of his having governed the nād at the feet of the god, having represented to his family priest Annadānîśvara and Vīraṇa-svāmi that he would set up a stone and make a grant of Siṟaṅgala in the Arukalugôḍ country.

1ಶುಭಮಸ್ತು | ನಮಸ್ತುಂಗಶಿરસಶ್ಚುಂಭಿ ಚಂದ್ರಚಾಮರಚಾರಯೇ | ತ್ರೈಲೋ
^ಜ್ಞಾನಗರಂಭಮಲಸ್ತಂಘಾಯಾಂಸಂಭವೇ || 2 ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀವಿಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯ
3ಸುತ್ತವಾಹನಸಾವಿರಂ ಒಂಭೂರುಸಂವತ್ಸರದದೇಷ್ಯಣ ದಿನಂ
^ಉದಯಕುಲೋದ್ಭವವರದ | ಸೋಮವಂಶದಕರ್ಣತರುಡಸತ್ವದಾಸತ್ರದ
5ರುಕುಸಾತಕಾರ್ಯ್ಯಯಿಗೆವೃಧ್ಮಮಂತ್ರ್ಯಮಂಡಳಕಪಂಖಲಕರ್ಣಕರ್ಕಟೋ
6ತ್ರುಂಗಗಂಗಾಧಿಪತಿನೇತ್ರಕ್ಕೇಯರಾಯರಜಯದೇವನಮಾವಕರಗಳಗಳ
7ಭೂಪಪುರ್ವಣ ಸುಧಾಕರವಿರದಯುರಾಯಜೆಯದೇವಮಾವಾಕರಗಳಗ
8ಳದೇವಪ್ರತಿಬಿಸಿಕೊಡದುರಗು | ತಾಯಿವ್ಯಥಭಾವಸುಸತಪವಿಪ್ರೆಂ
^ದ್ರೆಯುಗಳಿಗೆಪುಣ್ಯವಾಗಜೇಷ್ಠಯುವ್ಯಕ್ರೋಮ್ಯಾದೇವದೇವನೇತ್ರಮಯ್ದ್
10ಗರಿಅಲಗದಾನಿವಾಲಲೋಜಾನಸ್ವಾಮಿಯ | ಅಂಗರಂಗಭೋಗಣಯವೇದ್ವಕ್ಕ್
11ಸೆಲವಾಗಿಭಕ್ತ್ರಿಪೂಜಾವಕದಿಂದ | ಸಂಜರಾಯಪಟ್ಟಣಸೀವೆಯುಯೋ
12ಳಾಗವ | ತುಂಗದಶ್ಯಳಳವನೂ | ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಸುಲವಗ್ರಾಮಗಳುನ | ಬರಿಯ
13ಸಮುದ್ರಅನೇವಾಳಕುಲುಪನಹಳ್ಳಿಕುರುಉಲವುಮಕೂ
14ತ್ಕ ವಕಮೇಲೂರು | ಮಚೂರು | ಹುಲಿಯುನಹಪ್ಪಿ | ಹಂಗಿನಹ
15ಳುಉರುಗುಳವಿ | ಬಿಲಗಲಿ | ಸಹಗ್ರಾಮ ಗಳು | ರಾಪದೋರಸದ ಉದಗ್ವಾ
16ಮಹೋಜೋನೆಯನಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಅರಯನಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಹೊಸಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಕೀಗೆನಹಳ್ಳಿ |
17ಕೊಡಡಿಹಳ್ಳಿ | ನಾನಗಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಹಂದೂರದೇವಸಗ್ರಾಮ ಗಳು ಬಲಸೊಗೆಯ
18ಸ್ವಲಕಾಳನಲವಗ್ರಾಮ ಗಳು ಇಷ್ಟೋಳು| ಶೀಕ್ಷಗ್ರಾಮ ಶೀಕ್ಷನಿಸಿ..
19...................................ಸಿಕೊಟಿವಣಿಕೀತವರ್ಮಕ್ಕೆ ಅರೋ
20...................................ಗರುಡಯೆವವನೂ | ವಾರ
21...................................ಸು ಶ್ರೀವೀಠರಂಗಪ್ಪನು | ಸಾವರ...
22...................................ಕೊಂಡಪಾವಕೇಹೋಗೇನನು

cells.location: *At the same temple, on a stone in the cast wall.* [→ *At the same village, on a stone in the temple on the Mallikârjuna-be|ta.*]
cells.remarks: The service (apparently raising the wall) of Gaṅgādharayya, son of Cheunavira-Gauḍa of Svāsale, for the god Annadāni-Mallikārjuna, who in the Krita-yuga was worshipped by gods and rishis, in the Trētā-yuga was worshipped by Nāgārjuna, in the Dvāpara-yuga was worshipped by the purusha-mriga (or centaur) and the lightning, and in the Kali-yuga was worshipped by the cow (or by Kapila ṛishi).
cells.text_roman:
Krita-yugadalli Dēvarishi-kaiyalli pūje-koṇḍantha svāmi Trēta-yugadalli Nāgārjunana kaiyalli pūje-
koṇḍanthā svāmi Dvāpara-yugadalli purushamṛigada kailliyū sidhu-kaiyalli pūje-koṇḍantha svāmi Kali-
yugadalli kapile-kāli pūje-koṇḍantha Annadāni-Mallikārjuna-svāmiyavara śrī-pāda-padmaṅgalige Svāsi-
leya Chennavīra-Gāudara kumāra Gāṅgadharaiyyanu mādisidanthia, yi-sēve mānata
cells.text_original:
ಅದೇ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಪೂರ್ವ ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ನೆಟ್ಟ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 6' 6" x 2' 8".
1ಕ್ರತುಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿ ದೇವಪುಷಿಕ್ಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೃಷಿಕೋರಂಭಸ್ವಾಮಿಾ
2ತ್ರೇತಾಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿನಾಗಜಾರ್ಜುನಕ್ಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೃಷಿಕೋರಂಭಸ್ವಾಮಿಾ
3ದ್ವಾಪರಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿರುಫಾಮಮ್ಮಗಡಕ್ಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೃಷಿಕೋರಂಭಸ್ವಾಮಿಾ

ಹುಣಸೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು,
4칼ಲಿಯುಗದಲಿಕಿಪೀಲಕೆಯಿಪೂಜೆಕೊಂಡುಹಾಂಅನ್ನ ದಾನಿಮೆಲ್ಲಿಕಾರ್ಜುನನಸ್ವಾಮಿಯುಯವರೇಪ್ರಸಾದ
5ಪದ್ಮಂಗಲ್‌ಗಸ್ವನಸಲಿಯೆಚಂಬಿನವೀರಣಾಶಕರವರಂಗಂಧರ್ಕದ್ಯೆಯುನೊಮಾಡಿಸಿದಂ
6ಧಾಳಿಯಾಸೇಪವಲುನಸ್ತೃ

cells.location: *At bechirakh Mallikāthapura attached to Beṭṭadapura, on a stone in front of the Basava temple.*
cells.remarks: By order of Vīra-Harihara-Rāya,—Lakhanna-Vodeyar, to provide for the offerings (specified in great detail) to the god Mallikārjuna of Kuḍukûr, made a grant of Āpagondanahalli, a hamlet of Siṅgapaṭ- taṇa, assessed at 25 varāha, together with all the lands, channels and houses belonging thereto. Hunsûr Taluq. 89
cells.text_roman:
Yīśvara-samvatsara-Phālguna-su 1 lu śrīmatu vīra-Harihāra-Rāyara nirūpadim Lakhanna-Vodeyaru
Kuḷukura Mallikārjunadevarige dēvātārchanege kaṭṭaleya sāsana udayada avasarada kaṭṭalege
vastra su-gandha-dravya gandha karppūra kastūri su-gandha-pūrṇja dhūpa dīpa naivedya tāmbūla
paṅcha-parvvada pūjge vastra 3 ke ga 1 purpake ga 1, gandha ga 1, karppūra ga 1 kastūri ga 1
kuṅkuma ga 1 dhūpārte nanda-divigege tuppa ga 10 naivedya ga 3ī ādake yelegam prati-parvva 1
kke ga 1 u ga 5 nallayenne-majanake ga 1 ..... intu nadava dharmma kaṭṭalege ubbhayam saluva
varaha va 1 kam ga 9-5 varisam-prati nadasmvadake koṭta Siṅgapaṭṭanada kāluvaḷi
Apagoṇḍamhaliva 1 kam teruva Vīraha ga 25 aksharatadalu yippatta-ayidu honinna .... yāmi
Sivaratreya tithiyali Mallikārjuna-dēvara sannidhiyalu dhārā-pūrvvakav agi dharmma-nimittav agi
sarvvamānyav agi Lakana-Vodeyāru dēva-dāyige koṭṭarāgi a-haliya chatur-sime-volagina keyi
. . . gadde beddidi kaja mane muntagi en ulla Sīrvasvāmī suvarna-daya māḍikoṇḍu
a-dēvara pūjārigalu yi-kāṭṭaleyanu ṭapa ..... pūrvvakav āgi koṭṭa dēva-dāyiya kaṭṭajeya dharmma-
sāsana . . . . . (usual final phrases)

Hunsur Taluq.

cells.location: *At Hiri-Malali (*Beṭṭadapura hobli*), on a stone near the Basava temple.*
cells.remarks: There was in Dvārāvati, in the Lunar race, a king named Chāṅgalva; who, by victory, seized (for himself) the titles of king Bijjala. In his line was born the brave king named Nāga. From him the king Raṅga. From him the king Piryyana. From him the king Nañja, learned in the S'aiva-siddhānta. His younger brother, Mahādēva, famous for his bravery, made a grant of Hiryya-Malali for (the god) Annadāni-Liṅga, dweller on the top of the hill.

vijayad Bijjalendrasya birudani jahara yali ||
jatas tad-anvaye dhiro Naga-nama mahipatih |
tasmad Kaiiga-dharadhisas tasmat Piryyana-bhupatih ||
Nunja-kshamapatis tasmach-Chhaiva-siddhanta-k6vidah |
tasyauunjo Mahadeva-nripatih khyata-vikramah ||
chatur-viipsaty-uttara . chatus-sata-samanvite |
vritte S'akabde sahasre Rudhirodgari-vatsare ||
khyatannadani-Lingaya parvvatagra-nivasine |
Hiiyya-Malaliti-nama puram bhaktya samarppayat || sri

°ದಲ್ಯೆಕರಕಲೋಷ್ತ್ರಗೌರ್ಜೇಷಗಾಕ್ಕೆ
"ಬೀರಯ್ಯೇಕಾಂರರಾಜಮದೇಪಮಹಾಲ
ರಕರಾಗಳಾರ್ಥಪರಿಪುಣ್ಯ ರಾಸುಧಾಕರರಾದ
"ಹಿಯಾರರಾಜಯದೇಪಮಹಾದರಸುಗಳ
"ತಂದಪ್ರೇಕತಾಂಪೋಡೆಯುಗೋಬಾರಯಿ
"ವಲ್ಲಭಂಗುವಾಗೂಸೂರೀಯಡೇಗನೂ
"ಪುಣ್ಯವಗಜೇಕೊಂಡು | ಶ್ರೀಮಂಮಹಾದೇ
"ವದೇರಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ವಕ್ರೀಗಳಿಸಲಮಾನಿಮವ
"ళ్లಿಕಾರ್ಜ್‌ ಸನ್‌ಮ್ಮಿಯಅಂಗರಂಗಭೋೀ
"ಗನಾಯೀವದ್ರೆಕಲವಾಭಿಕ್ಷೆಸ್ಥವಪ್ಯಕ್
"ವೀರಣರಾಜಯಾರುಪವಮೃದಸೀಯೋಳಗದ
"ತುಂಗದನ್ಸ್‌ ಲವನೋಅಲದೇಶಲುವಗ್ರಾಮ
"ಗಳಬಿನಸಮುದ್ರ | ಅನೇಮಾಲ | ಲಕುವದ |
"ಕಲುವಳಾಕಿ | ಹಂದಿಗನಹಳ್ಳಿ | ಸ.ರೋಗು
"ಪಳ್ಳ | ಬಿಳಚುಲಿ | ಮರುದೂರು | ಕೊತ್ತು ವಳ್‌
(ಮುಂದೆ ಬರವಣಿಗೆಯಿಲ್ಲ)

text.location: *On another stone in the same place.*
text.remarks:

cells.location: *At Haradûru (*Beṭṭadapura hobli*), on a stone near the Basava temple.*
cells.remarks: Amesiya-ayya, (son) of Virupaya-amma, in order that his mother might obtain merit, made for the god Sōmanātha of Haradūr a grant to provide for a *matha* and a perpetual lamp.

ayyagalu a . . mmagalige punya âgabek endu bitta ârambhada mata-samya bêdige saha nandâ-divi[ge]ge
bitta mata 1 i-dharmmake *(usual imprecatory phrases)*

ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಬಸವಣ್ಣ ಗುಡಿಯ ಬಳಿ ನೇಟ್ಟು ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 4' 6" X 3'.
1 ಫಲನಸವತ್ಸರದೆಳಕಣಬ
2 ಗಿ ಸೋಲುಹಪರದುರಸೋಲುನೂಸಾತ
3 ದೇವಗಿರಿಯುರುಯಉಂಗಮಗಳ
4 ಆವಸಿಯಉಅಪ್ಪುಗಳಳಅಂ
5 ಮ್ಯಾಗಗೆಪುಣ್ಯಅಲಗಳೇಷೆಂದು
6 ಹಿಟ್ಟ್ಯಅರಂಭದಪದತ್ಸಾವಮ್ದಣೇಗೆ
7 ಸಾಹನದಾದಿವಿಗೊಳಿಸದಟ
8 ಗಿ ಇಥವಮ್ಕಾಳೀಲಾಲರಉತುದವ
9 ರುಗಂಗೆಯೆತುದಯಉಕುಪಿಲೆಯಉಕೊಂ
10 ದಮಾಪಹಕೋಳುಹರುನಾಯುವಮಾಲು
11 ಸವತಿಂಒಬರುಮಂಗಳ ಮಹಶ್ರೀೇ

text.location: At Kûragallu (*Beṭṭadapura hobli*), on a stone in Patel Gópayya's field, north of the village.
text.remarks:
*[Kannada original]*
Kuragallu
*[English translation, Gemini-rendered, verify]*
Kuragallu

*Date about 920 A.D.*

While Permmanaḍi was ruling the kingdom of the world :—Ereyappa ruling the Koṅgal-nāḍ
Eight-thousand, and Bûtuga's queen Paramabbe ruling Kûrgal.—Kûrgal-Gavuṇḍa and two others
with him, fighting for the cows, died. For this, Ereyapparasa gave 3 *kaṇdugas* of land as a *kalnāḍ*.
Witnesses (4 named).Read more (1 KB)

cells.remarks: Rudra-Gana of Nañjarāyapaṭṭaṇa, son of the mahā-maṇḍalika-maṇḍalēśvara Kulōttuṅga-Chāṅgalva Chenyaya, worshipper of the god Mallikārjuna,—in order that his father S'rikaṇṭha-Rājaiya, his mother Vallabhāmbā, and Rudra-Gana might obtain final beatitude,—made a grant for the god Chandrasēkhara of Koḍumbali as follows:—Having erected a maṭha for distribution of food to those who come to the car-festival of the god Annadāni-Mallikārjuna of Bhairavapura, caused his guru to take up his residence in the king's maṭha, to conduct the worship of Chandrasēkhara and to minister to the Jaṅgamas, and give shelter and food to mendicants and pilgrims,—in order to meet all the expenses of the same, made a grant of Hāraṇahalli, 94 Hunsur Taluq.

Hunsur Taluq. 153

Vira-Rajayanavara garbha-paripuruna-sudhakarar ada Nanjarayapatharada rajyada arasu Virapa-
rajyayavaru tamma tande-tayigalige punyav agali yendu Tirumalapurada gramavan ubara ... rala
samayacharada mathada piriyarugalige sila-sasanav agi kalla netti koteu yi-dharmmake (usual final
phrases)
cells.text_original:
ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ದೊಡ್ಡನೇಲಲ್ ಗ್ರಾಮಕ್ಕೆ ಪೂರ್ವ ಕೂನಿನಿಕೆರೆಯ ಕೋಟಿಯ ಬಲ ಮಂಟೇಮೇಲೆ.
ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 6' × 3' 6".
1[ಶ್ರೀ*]ಲಭವಸ್ತು ನಮಸ್ತುಂ ಗಂಗೇರಸ್ತು ಒಂಬಿತಂದ್ರಣಾ
2ಮೂ(ಸು)ರಚೌರವರೇತ್ರ ತ್ರಿಲೋಕ್ಯನಗರಂರಂಭಣಮುಲನ್ಮ ಒಂಭಾಯ್
ಸಂಹ
3ವೇ[ಸೀ*]ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಸ್ರಿವಿಜಯನಾಧು ದಯೂಸ೯ಲಿವಾಸಿನಕಶವರ್ವರುಸಂಕುಳಿ
4ವೇಯಪರಧಾಳಸಂವತ್ಸರ ನದವೈಶಾಖಬೂಟು ೪ಲೊಯುದುಕುಳೊತ್ರದೈ
ವರಾ
5ದಸೋಮೇವನದಹಕರಿತೋತ್ರದಚ್ಯಉಲ್ಯುಯಾನಸೂತ್ರಪ್ರವರುಕಾಸ್ತು
6ಕದ್ಮ್ಯುಯಿಗಳವೇಯಮನ್ನಮಹಮಂದಧಾಕವಂಘಾಳಸ್ರ್ಹಕಕಳೋತ್ಹೂ
7ತ್ರ೧ ೧ಗಂಕೆಂಗಲ್‌ಶ್ರೀವೀಠಿಕ್ಷೀರಕಾಂಠರಾಜುಮನವರಕೌಮವರವಿವರ
8[ರಂ*]ಜಯಿನವರಘರ್ಭಪರಪೂನಸುಧಾಕಕರಚಾದವಂಣಜಾಯು
9ವೀರಣಪರಾಂಟೋಣೆಯ್ . . . ವೀರಪರಾಜಪವನರುತಂವತಂದೆ
10ತಾಯಿಗ೯ಗೆಪ್ಪುಣ್ಯಾವಗಳಿಯುವಂತಿರುಮುಲಪ್ರದರಗ್ಯಾ
11ಮುವನುಪದವರವಿರಳ್ಹಸನಮಯಾ೯ಜ೯ದದವಶದಪಿರಿವರು
12ಗಳ್ಳಾಗೇಲೊಸಸಹನವಾಕೀಕಲ್ಲಿನಿಷ್ಟ್ಕೊಟುಲುಯಿಅಧರ್ಮವ಼್ಕೇ
13ಅರೊಟಬುರುಅಳಮುದರಕತಮತಂದೆತಾಯಿಗುರುದೈವನೋ಼
14ಉತ್ಸ್ರ್ಹವರವರಕಗಾಸಿಕಲೇಕೂದವಪಜ ಕೋಜಾರುಯಿಎ೦
15ದರುಕೊಳುಅಸಿನಾಸನಕಸೇಣುಭಮಸ್ತುಂ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಕರೀಕಲ್ಲು ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಬಸವಣ್ಣನ ಗುಡಿಯ ಮುಂದೆ ನೆಟ್ಟು ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 3' 3" × 4'.
1[ಶ್ರೀ*]ರುಭಮಸ್ತು ನಮಸ್ತು ಗಂಗಿರಕಳಚೆವಕಮರ(ಸುರ)ಬಾ
2ರವೆತ್ರ ತ್ರಿಲೋಕ್ಯನಗರಂರಂಭೋಮೂಲನ್ಮ ಉಭಾಯಸಂಭವಸೀಸತ್ಸ್ವ್ರೀ
3ವಿಜಯದ್ಭುಥೆಯ್ಹಸೀಲಿವಾಹನಸಕವರುಷ ೧೪೯೫ನೇದುಲರು
4ದಿಗಸಂವತ್ಸರದ ಜೇಷ್ಠಯು ೧ ಶ್ರೀಯೆಜಕುಲೊರ್ಧ್ವ ವರಾನ್ಸೋ(ಮವನಸದಪತೇಣೋ೯
5[ತ್ತ್ಯ್ಕ*]ದಅಫಲಾಯುಯಾಸೂತ್ರಪದರುಕಸಾಧುಬ್ಯ್ಹಾಗ್ಯುಲದವ್ಯ್ಹಮಂನ್ಯಹಮಂ

ಹುಣಸೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು.
$^1$ದೊಡ್ಡಮಂದಲೇಶ್ವರಕಳುತೃಂಟಗಣಗಳ್ಯವಿರೇನಂಜರಾಮದೇವೇವಮಂ
$^2$ಹಾಳರಿನಸಳೇಕೊಪೂರುನ್ಶೇ^ಳಕೇಲರಾಜಯ್ಯದೇವಮಾಪಾಳಸಗಳಕೂಮರವೀರಯ್ಯ
$^3$ಜಯುನವವರಗರ್ಭಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣಕಸುಧಾಕರೌಧನಂಜರಾಯನವರದರಾಜ್ಯದಲ್ಲನ್ಯನೀರ
$^4$ರಾಜಯುದೇವಮಹಾವೇಅರಗ್ಗಲ || . . . . . ಧರ್ಮದನಮಯಾಚಾರದಮರಕಳನೆಲವಾಗಿ
10 . . . . . . . . ಪುರದಗುಸ್ತನವನು || . . . ವೀರರಾಜಳವಸನಗೇಗೆಪುಣ್ಯಾಚಾರಿಯಂ
$^11$ದುಕ್ಕೊಟ್ಟುಗ್ರಮವಕತೆಸಲಾಸಸನಕವಂಗಳಮಯಾ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ

cells.remarks: Piriya-Râjayya-Dēva-mahā-arasu, son of S'rīkaṇṭha-Râjayya, king of Nañjarâyapattana (with usual titles), in order that his ? adopted son Prāṇadhāreya Piri-Vōdeyar might attain to Kailāsa, made in his name a grant of Pirisamudra for the lights of the Kārttika-pūjā of the god Annadāni-Mallikârjuna of S'rigiri.
cells.text_roman:
Subham astu |
namas tunga-siras-chumbi-chandra-chamara-charave |
trailokya-nagararambha-mula-stambhaya S'ambhave ||

Svasti sri vijayabhyudaya-S'alivahana-saka-varusa 1512 varusa sanda Khara-samvatsarada Karttika-
su 15 lu sriman-mahadeva devottama S'rigiri-Annadani-Mallikarjuna-svamiya Karttika-pujeya dipakke 1
Soma-vamsada Riku-sakeya Harita-gotrada Asvalayana-sutrada Nanjarayapattanada arasugalu S'ri-
kantha-Rajayyanavara kumarar ada Piriya-Rajayya-Deva-maha-arasugalavaru tamma saku-maga Prana-
dhareya Piri-Voderige Kailasa-prapti agaliy endu a-Pranadhareya Piri-Vodeyara hesarali a-chandrarkka-
sthayiy agi nadadu barali endu kotta Pirisamudrada dharma-sila-sasana | yi-dharmake Nanjaraya-
patta[na]da doregal agali manusyaru makkal agali aru alupisaru avau ige guru-drohi | linga-drohi |
jangama-drohi | deva-loka-martya-lokakke horagu | tirta-prasadake horagu | tanna hendatiya sama-
bhavage kottavanu | tanna hetta taya tane . . . . . . . . .

cells.location: *At the same village, on a stone in the basti.*
cells.remarks: Praise of the Jina sâsana. S'rutakītti-Dēva,—the dear chief disciple of Prabhēndu, the disciple of S'ruta-muni, the disciple of Abhayachandra-siddhānta-chakravartti, of the Mûla-saṅgha, Dēsiya-gaṇa, Pustuka-gachcha, Koṇḍakuṇdānvaya, and Iṅgulēsvara-bali,—having wedded the lady final beatitude (i. e. died), his disciple Ādideva-muni and all the blessed people (i. e. Jains) of the S'ruta-gaṇa, set up his image, and the Tīrthaṅkara Sumati, and repaired this chaityālaya.
cells.text_roman:
S'rimat-parama-gambhira-syad-vadamogha-lainchhanam |
jiyat trailokya-nathasya sasanam Jina-sasanam ||

svasti srimad-raya-raja-guru-mandalacharyyar enisi Sri-Mula-sangha Desiya-gana Pustaka-gachchha
Kondakundanvaya Virigulesvarada bali srimad-Abhayachandra-siddhanta-chakravarttigalu tat-sishyara
cells.text_original:
ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 6'6" x 2'.
^[ಶ್ರೀ]ಮತುಪ್ರವರ್ಗಮಗಳಿರ್ತ್ಯಾದ್ಯದೈವಪ್ರೋತ್ಫಲಾಂತ
^[ಸಂಚೆ]ಯಾತೃಯೊಳುತ್ಯಕ್ಯಾನಘನ್ಯಸಾನಸಂಜಿ
^[ಸನಾಸ]ನಂ || ಕೃಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಮಧ್ಯಾಧಾರರಾಜಗುರುವಂ
^[ದಪಳ]ಬಾಖ್ಯಾಗರೈಸಿತ್ತ್ರಷಮೂಲಸಂಘ
^[ದೇ]ಶಿಗಣಪ್ರಸಂಗ ಕಾಶೃಕ್ಕೊಂಕೊಂಡು
^[ನ್ಯ]ಯೊಯುಂಗೀಳ್ರದಬಳಿಕ್ರೀಮದ
^[ಭ]ಯಜಂದ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತೇಕತ್ತ್ರ್ಯಾಗಳಾತಸ್ತಿ
^[ಪ್ಪ]ನೃತ್ಯತ್ರಿಶ್ರುತಮುನಿಗಳ ತಸ್ತಿಪ್ಪೃಪುರಪೀಠಂ
^[ದುಗ]ಳಚಅವರಸಿ ಯಾಸ್ನಸಿಸ್ಥ ಪ್ರಯಿತ್ತುಸತ್
^[ಕೀರ್ತಿ] ರದ್ವೇವರುಕವಪತ್ಥ ಗಖಿಂಸೆಯೊರುಧ
^[ರೋದ್ರಾ]ರಿಅಣಂವತ್ಸರ ದದ್ಯ್ವಿತೀಯಭಾದ್ರಪದ
^[ಬಲ] ಆಅಧಿತ್ಯವಾರದಉಲುಮುಕ್ತಿ ವಧುವೆ
^[ಕ್ಯ]ಲಭ್ರಂರ್ಧುರತತ್ಪತಿನಿಧಿಯನಸೂಮತಿ
^[ತಿಷ್ಯ]: ಶರಣುಕಾಣೆಕ್ಟ್ರತ್ವಾಲ[ಯು]ದಜೇಷ್ಠೋರ್ತ್ಯಾದ್ರವ
^[ಹ]ಲವರತ್ಷ್ಟ್ವರುಅಭಿಡೇಪವಮನಿಗಳಳು
^[ಕೃತ್ಯಗಣಮುಖ್ಯನಾದಸವನು ಭವ್ಯಜನಂಗಳಳು
^[ವಾಣಿ]ವಿಕಳನವದ್ಯಗತಾಂಜಿನೇಶಕನಂ

text.location: *At the same village, on a stone in the basti.*
text.remarks:
Praise of the Jina sâsana.

S'rutakītti-Dēva,—the dear chief disciple of Prabhēndu, the disciple of S'ruta-muni, the disciple
of Abhayachandra-siddhānta-chakravartti, of the Mûla-saṅgha, Dēsiya-gaṇa, Pustuka-gachcha, Koṇḍakuṇdānvaya,
and Iṅgulēsvara-bali,—having wedded the lady final beatitude (i. e. died), his disciple
Ādideva-muni and all the blessed people (i. e. Jains) of the S'ruta-gaṇa, set up his image, and the Tīrthaṅkara
Sumati, and repaired this chaityālaya.Read more (1 KB)
text.text_roman: S'rimat-parama-gambhira-syad-vadamogha-lainchhanam |jiyat trailokya-nathasya sasanam Jina-sasanam ||svasti srimad-raya-raja-guru-mandalacharyyar enisi Sri-Mula-sangha Desiya-gana Pustaka-gachchhaKondakundanvaya Virigulesvarada bali srimad-Abhayachandra-siddhanta-chakravarttigalu tat-sishyara
text.text_original: ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 6'6" x 2'.^[ಶ್ರೀ]ಮತುಪ್ರವರ್ಗಮಗಳಿರ್ತ್ಯಾದ್ಯದೈವಪ್ರೋತ್ಫಲಾಂತ^[ಸಂಚೆ]ಯಾತೃಯೊಳುತ್ಯಕ್ಯಾನಘನ್ಯಸಾನಸಂಜಿ^[ಸನಾಸ]ನಂ || ಕೃಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಮಧ್ಯಾಧಾರರಾಜಗುರುವಂ^[ದಪಳ]ಬಾಖ್ಯಾಗರೈಸಿತ್ತ್ರಷಮೂಲಸಂಘ^[ದೇ]ಶಿಗಣಪ್ರಸಂಗ ಕಾಶೃಕ್ಕೊಂಕೊಂಡು^[ನ್ಯ]ಯೊಯುಂಗೀಳ್ರದಬಳಿಕ್ರೀಮದ^[ಭ]ಯಜಂದ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತೇಕತ್ತ್ರ್ಯಾಗಳಾತಸ್ತಿ^[ಪ್ಪ]ನೃತ್ಯತ್ರಿಶ್ರುತಮುನಿಗಳ ತಸ್ತಿಪ್ಪೃಪುರಪೀಠಂ^[ದುಗ]ಳಚಅವರಸಿ ಯಾಸ್ನಸಿಸ್ಥ ಪ್ರಯಿತ್ತುಸತ್^[ಕೀರ್ತಿ] ರದ್ವೇವರುಕವಪತ್ಥ ಗಖಿಂಸೆಯೊರುಧ^[ರೋದ್ರಾ]ರಿಅಣಂವತ್ಸರ ದದ್ಯ್ವಿತೀಯಭಾದ್ರಪದ^[ಬಲ] ಆಅಧಿತ್ಯವಾರದಉಲುಮುಕ್ತಿ ವಧುವೆ^[ಕ್ಯ]ಲಭ್ರಂರ್ಧುರತತ್ಪತಿನಿಧಿಯನಸೂಮತಿ^[ತಿಷ್ಯ]: ಶರಣುಕಾಣೆಕ್ಟ್ರತ್ವಾಲ[ಯು]ದಜೇಷ್ಠೋರ್ತ್ಯಾದ್ರವ^[ಹ]ಲವರತ್ಷ್ಟ್ವರುಅಭಿಡೇಪವಮನಿಗಳಳು^[ಕೃತ್ಯಗಣಮುಖ್ಯನಾದಸವನು ಭವ್ಯಜನಂಗಳಳು^[ವಾಣಿ]ವಿಕಳನವದ್ಯಗತಾಂಜಿನೇಶಕನಂ

cells.location: *At Makōḍu (Chikkunda hobli), on the pillars of the Basava temple.*
cells.remarks: Resolving to erect a temple in Mâkôd, with faith in Mahêśvara, Sômôja, with all due offerings of clothing and food, set this up in the earth. What a promise is this! Go not to the avaricious, ye learned : go to Sômôja, and he will bestow on you the wishing-tree, the cow of plenty, gold and vesture.
cells.text_roman:
*(South-east pillar)*

Sthira-sallakshaṇa-yuktam age nayadim Makōḍinol vachcha-sach- |
charitāṅ g abhyudayārtham age bharadīni dēvalāyam māḍal end |
irad abhinna negalge belpa vanamain vastrannamaṁ koṭṭu tatp |
vara-Mahēśvara-bhaktiyin niḷisidaṁ Sōmōjaṁ i-dhātriyoḷ ||

ēmata vibhudha lubudharaṇ | 5-manujara bēdavēda kalpa-kujatātpi |

cells.text_original:
ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ವೂಕೋಡು ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಬಸವೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಕಂಭಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ.
ಆಗ್ನೇಯ ಕಂಭ
$^1$ಸ್ತಿರಲ್ಲತ್ನಯುಕ್ತ ಮಾರ್ಗನಯನಿಂದ ವೂಕೋೇನೊಲವಕ್ಷ ಸಜ್ಞ ರಿತಂ
$^2$ಗಣ್ಯುದಯಾರ್ಥ್‌ರ್ಧದಿಂದೇವಲಯವಮ್ನದಂದೆಂದರಾವಿನ್ಯ ನೇಗಲ್ ಪೆಳ್ವ
$^3$ವನಮವನ್ನಾಸ್ಯೆನ್ನ ಮಂಕುಟ್ಟುತಾಂವರವರ್ನಾಹೇಶ್ವರಭಕ್ತಿ ಯಿನ್ನಿ ಲಿಸದನಿಸೋೇ
$^4$ಮೇೋಜಿನಿದಾತ್ರಿಯೊಳು ॥
ಈಶಾನ್ಯ ಕಂಭ
$^5$ವಿವನಾತವಿಪ್ರಧುಲಭರನೆವನುಜರಪ್ಹದವೇದಕಲ್ಪ ಪೂಜಾಂಕಶಾಮಿ
$^6$ಸಿಮದಿವೇದಫ್ನು ವಸೂೇವೋೇಜನಭರ್ಡದನೇಪ್ರೋಕನಕಾಂಭರವ ॥

cells.location: At Dharmāpura (Bilikere hobli), on a stone in the raṅga-maṇṭapa of the Channakēśava temple.
cells.remarks: Praise of Nârâyana; and of Kêśava and S'iva. Of the Poysalas, lords of Dvârâvati, having the tiger crest, born in S'asâpura, was king Vinayâditya. That celebrated king Benayita's son was king Eraga. That king Erayanga's son, surrounded with subject kings, was the widely renowned king Vishnu. To describe that Vishnu-Dêva's valour.—The Tulu country, Chakragotta, Talavanapura, Uchchangi, Kôlâla, the seven Males, Vallûr, Kâñchi, Kongu, the clamorous Hâdiyaghatta, Bayalnad, the Nilachala hill fort, the great Râyarâyapuri, Tereyûr, Kôvatûr, and the Gondavâdi-sthala (all these) he took by a frown, the valiant strong-armed Vishnu-bhûpa. The mighty towering Ghats, beginning from Talemale, when he had trodden them to powder under the tramp of his great army, he marched over and brought down the swelling pride of Kongu and Bengiri as he plucked up their areca and cocoa-nut groves. Yama feared to straighten his (own) moustache, the sign of his manhood; enemies prostrate at his toe-nails feared to breathe; the proud feared to look lest the flame of his glory should consume them :—such was the brilliance of his valour. To Vishnu, Lakshmi-dêvi was the wife, and to these two was born, an earthquake to the mountains the hostile kings, distinguished by all the signs of fortune, the king Narasimha. To describe that Nârasinga-Dêva's valour :—(after several praises)—He took for his own the Chôla country, overcame the Mâlava king, agreed with the Gûrjara king, expanded the ? Anga king, assented to the Vanga king, and drove away the Kongu Kalinga râja,—possessed of uncommon valour, of immeasurable qualities, the king Narasimha. His sword, like a Makali, longed to devour the Mâlava, Khacha, Pândya, Nêpâla, Chôla, Vanga and Andhra kings. Though a son, this Nrisimha was greater than even his father in might and valour ; and double, treble, quadruple, quintuple of the celebrated hero Vishnu. When his war drums sounded, Pândya's chest split open like a door broken in two, Chôla's brave words diminished a hundred-fold, Chêra's heart suddenly began to palpitate, Andhra's stoutness was reduced by his beating of himself, Âlva sank down. Bringing into subjection the kings of Dravila, Magadha, Pânchâla, Nêpâla and Lâla, he ruled his country with power and glory, the ornament of the Yâdava race, the king Narasimha. Hunsûr Taluq. 97 While, (with usual titles), Hoysaḷa Narasimha-Devâ was in the capital of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom of the world in peace and wisdom :—giving to Togaravâḍi of Aridavâlike and Bûvana- haḷḷi of Manne, with their hamlets, the name of Dharmmapura, he made a grant of it for the deco- rations, offerings and temple repairs of the god Keśava, making it over in the presence of the great minister Daṇḍanâyaka Bitteyanna, the senior treasurer Hullayya, the master of the robes Surigeya, Nāgayya and Lakkumayya, into the hands of Śrîdhara the chief man (of the temple), free of all im- posts, to continue as long as sun, moon and stars. Praise of Bittiga, Vishnu's general, of the Karṇāṭa-vaṁśa, who had subdued Nilachala, cut off the head of Kāla, and reduced to powder the Koṅga army. The great minister, sarvvâdhikâri, Daṇḍanâyaka Bittiyanna made, for the god Keśava of Dharmmapura, a grant of the houses in the town, (? the payments in) gold, the export dues, the im- port dues, the tax on oil-mills, the tax on potters, the tax on washermen, the tax on prostitutes, the tax on carts, the tax on masons, the tax on basket-makers, the tax on shepherds, the tax ........, the tax on 500 ploughs of pannâya, and the tax on barbers. Praises of Aridavâḷke, the most prosperous and fertile region in the Fourteen nāds, as Gaṅgavāḍi was in the Kuṇṭala country of the Bhārata land. In it the nād-prabhu, of the Nandi kula, was as if the sun had blossomed in a golden flower. Among the ornaments of the world was the agrahāra of Ahichchhatra in the north. The Gaṅga kings having gone there in the course of a victorious expedition, brought from it fifty chief Brahmans, for the increase of their own fortune. Descended from whom was Kaṇṇameya, of the Prāvatsanda- kula and the Hārīta-gôtra. His wife was Machavve. Śrîdhare was their son. Boundaries of Dharmmapura. Imprecatory verses.

text.location: At Dharmāpura (Bilikere hobli), on a stone in the raṅga-maṇṭapa of the Channakēśava temple.
text.remarks:
Praise of Nârâyana; and of Kêśava and S'iva.

Of the Poysalas, lords of Dvârâvati, having the tiger crest, born in S'asâpura, was king Vinayâditya. That celebrated king Benayita's son was king Eraga. That king Erayanga's son, surrounded with subject kings, was the widely renowned king Vishnu.

To describe that Vishnu-Dêva's valour.—The Tulu country, Chakragotta, Talavanapura, Uchchangi, Kôlâla, the seven Males, Vallûr, Kâñchi, Kongu, the clamorous Hâdiyaghatta, Bayalnad, the Nilachala hill fort, the great Râyarâyapuri, Tereyûr, Kôvatûr, and the Gondavâdi-sthala (all these) he took by a frown, the valiant strong-armed Vishnu-bhûpa. The mighty towering Ghats, beginning from Talemale, when he had trodden them to powder under the tramp of his great army, he marched over and brought down the swelling pride of Kongu and Bengiri as he plucked up their areca and cocoa-nut groves. Yama feared to straighten his (own) moustache, the sign of his manhood; enemies prostrate at his toe-nails feared to breathe; the proud feared to look lest the flame of his glory should consume them :—such was the brilliance of his valour.

To Vishnu, Lakshmi-dêvi was the wife, and to these two was born, an earthquake to the mountains the hostile kings, distinguished by all the signs of fortune, the king Narasimha. To describe that Nârasinga-Dêva's valour :—(after several praises)—He took for his own the Chôla country, overcame the Mâlava king, agreed with the Gûrjara king, expanded the ? Anga king, assented to the Vanga king, and drove away the Kongu Kalinga râja,—possessed of uncommon valour, of immeasurable qualities, the king Narasimha. His sword, like a Makali, longed to devour the Mâlava, Khacha, Pândya, Nêpâla, Chôla, Vanga and Andhra kings. Though a son, this Nrisimha was greater than even his father in might and valour ; and double, treble, quadruple, quintuple of the celebrated hero Vishnu. When his war drums sounded, Pândya's chest split open like a door broken in two, Chôla's brave words diminished a hundred-fold, Chêra's heart suddenly began to palpitate, Andhra's stoutness was reduced by his beating of himself, Âlva sank down. Bringing into subjection the kings of Dravila, Magadha, Pânchâla, Nêpâla and Lâla, he ruled his country with power and glory, the ornament of the Yâdava race, the king Narasimha.

Hunsûr Taluq. 97

While, (with usual titles), Hoysaḷa Narasimha-Devâ was in the capital of Dôrasamudra, ruling
the kingdom of the world in peace and wisdom :—giving to Togaravâḍi of Aridavâlike and Bûvana-
haḷḷi of Manne, with their hamlets, the name of Dharmmapura, he made a grant of it for the deco-
rations, offerings and temple repairs of the god Keśava, making it over in the presence of the great
minister Daṇḍanâyaka Bitteyanna, the senior treasurer Hullayya, the master of the robes Surigeya,
Nāgayya and Lakkumayya, into the hands of Śrîdhara the chief man (of the temple), free of all im-
posts, to continue as long as sun, moon and stars.

Praise of Bittiga, Vishnu's general, of the Karṇāṭa-vaṁśa, who had subdued Nilachala, cut off
the head of Kāla, and reduced to powder the Koṅga army.

The great minister, sarvvâdhikâri, Daṇḍanâyaka Bittiyanna made, for the god Keśava of
Dharmmapura, a grant of the houses in the town, (? the payments in) gold, the export dues, the im-
port dues, the tax on oil-mills, the tax on potters, the tax on washermen, the tax on prostitutes, the
tax on carts, the tax on masons, the tax on basket-makers, the tax on shepherds, the tax ........,
the tax on 500 ploughs of pannâya, and the tax on barbers.

Praises of Aridavâḷke, the most prosperous and fertile region in the Fourteen nāds, as Gaṅgavāḍi
was in the Kuṇṭala country of the Bhārata land. In it the nād-prabhu, of the Nandi kula, was as if
the sun had blossomed in a golden flower.

Among the ornaments of the world was the agrahāra of Ahichchhatra in the north. The Gaṅga
kings having gone there in the course of a victorious expedition, brought from it fifty chief Brahmans,
for the increase of their own fortune. Descended from whom was Kaṇṇameya, of the Prāvatsanda-
kula and the Hārīta-gôtra. His wife was Machavve. Śrîdhare was their son.

ಅತನನೆತಿಸಲಗಾಣ್ಮವೇಶನಪತಿ*^ಬ್ರಿತಸುಲಭಗಾನ್ಯಾತ್ಪೆಯಾದೂಬೀಣಸೀತೆಬಯಿನಲ್ಲದೇವಾನುಜಾತಯಸುಲವನುಜೆಬಕ್ಕು ವೇತ್ರಪಾತಪೆಯುಂ ॥ ಏನೆನಗಳ ವಾಣಿಜಕಿಬೈಗೆ ಗವನನುಗುಣಿಯಸುನೀಚೆಕ್ಕಮ್ಮ^'^ಯುಂಗಣತನಯುಪುರ್ವ್ವಾಪ್ಪಿದನಬಟ್ಟಿ ^ಪ್ಟ್ವಾಜ್ಞಾಸುಜಾತ್ರ ಸಂಪಡಂತಿಧರಯಂ : ಶ್ರೀಧರವ್ಯಾಪ್ತ ಪದವೇಸವಾರ್ಪುವ್ಯಾಪದಸೆ ಜಿಬೃಥದವಟ್ಟ್ಯ ಕಸ್ಸಿಟಿತ^'ಸುಲಬಾಳಿಂಜೆಯಿಯಯಕಳಿಂಗೋಳ್ಳುವೇದಾವಿರುಯಸಹಜಿಗೆಲ್ಲನಟ್ಟಿ ಕಳಧಮ್ಯ್ರಾಪುರದತಿಸುಜಲನಾಗವಂದೆಳಿಸಿನಿಧಿ^''ಯಹಾಸಜಿಗೆಲ್ಲನಟ್ಟಿ ಕಳಸ್ಯಾವದೀಣದೆಸೆಯಂಸೋಚೆಧಮ್ಮ್ರಾ ಪುರದೊಂಬತ್ತು ನಡಳ್ಳಿ ಗೌಕೋರ್ಬಡೆಟ್ಯ ಯೂನಟ್ಟಿಕ್ಕಳಧಮ್ಯ್ರಾಪುರದತಚೊರಿಯು^'ಕಲ್ಲಮಮಧ್ಯನಹಳ್ಳಿಯತ್ರಿ ಗಂಧಿಯಹುಡಿಯೇಕುಯಳನ್ನ ಕಳಪಿಸ್ಬ್ಟಿ ವದನೆೆಯೂನೋಸೀತ್ಯ್ನಿಳಧಮ್ಯ್ರಾಪುರದಕಟ್ಟ್ಯಬುಂಡಬೆಟ್ಟು ಯೂವೆಳ್ಳಹುಣಸೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು. 273^5^ದದದದವತ್ಕಲ್ಲುಧರ್ಮ ^ರಾಫೆರದಉದ್ದು ರತಿಶುನ್ನಾ ರತಿ ಸಂಧಿಯನ್ನು ತನ್ನ ಕಲ್ಲು ಉತ ರದೆ ನಯನೋಡಿಕೆ ಕೂದಿನಕಡಿಯುಂತ ಕಂಶೋೀಡಿಯೊಜೇ^5^ಶ್ಲೋಲ್ಪ ಯಂಕೂಣಿಬೀೆಂಚಣಾಪುರ ದ ಹಜೀ ಗನ ಹಯ್ಯೂ ಟಟ್ಯೊತ್ಯುನ್ನ ತು ಕಲ್ಲು ಹಿಂಡಿ ಜೆಯುಕ್ಕೊಳ ಧಮ್ಯಾ^ ನಾ ಯಿ ಯರಕ ವಿಲ ಯಂ ಕೂಂಡ ಕಳ ಗ೦ ಯೊ೦ ದ ಲ ಕ ಟ್ಯ ಸಿ ನ ಸ ರು ವ ಜ ವ ದ ಪ ರ್ಣಗ ಪ್ಲಿಬ್ರ ಹ್ಮ ಣ್ಣ ಂಗೆಪೃವೆರನ^58 ^ ಕೌಷ್ಟು ಷ್ಯ ವಲ ವ ನ ಜ ಯು ವರು ಕ ಧ ಮ್ಯ ^ ರ್ಣ ವ ನಾವ ನಾ ವ ನಾ ಕು ಜಿದ ವ ೦ ಗೇಂ ವ : ರ ಣಾಸೀ ಕ ರುಕ್ಷೇ ತ ವ ಳ್ಳ ಸ್ಯಾವ ಕ ವಿ ಲ ಯ ಸಂ ಯಿ ಯ ರವೇದಪಾ^59 ^ ರ ಗ ರ ಪ ವ್ಲಿಬ್ರಾ ಹ್ಮ ಣ ರ ಗ ನ ದ ಸ ಾ ಯು ರ ತ ಥಾ ರ್ಪಥಾ ನ ದು ವ ೦ ತ ವ ಸ್ಟ್ರಾ ಸ್ತ್ರ ರ ಗ ಳ ೦ . ಕೌಂ ದ ಲ ವ ಕ ಮ ಹ ವಾ ಪ ತ ಕ ವ ನೇ ದ ಯು ವ ರ ು ||ಪ್ರಿ ಯು^60 ^ ದಿ ೦ ಚಿ ತಿ ದ ನೆ ಯ ಲ್ಲಿ ತ್ಯಂ^63 ^ ಯಾ ಯೋ ರ್ಹ ರ ತಿ ವ ಸ ಸು ಧ ರ ಪ ವ ಸ್ಯಿ ವೃ ^ ಕ ರ ಕ ಸ ಹ ಸು ಸಂ ^ ತ್ನಿ ಕಾಂ ವಿಷ್ಟ ^ ಜೂ ೦ ಜಾಯ ತೇ ಕೀ ಮಿ ||Footnote34. 34 cells.location: At Tarilcallu (Bilikere hobli), on a stone to the south of the Kasi-liriiga temple.
cells.remarks: While, (with usual prelude), the rājâdhirāja rāja-paramēśvara vira-pratāpa Dēva-Rāja-Vodeyar of Maisûr, seated on the throne of Śrîraṅgapattana, was ruling the kingdom of the world in peace :—his son Kaṇṭhirava-mahipâla (usual family descent in detail), forming in Tarriyakallu an agrahāra named Kaṇṭhiravasamudra,—made a grant for it of the village of Tarrikallu belonging to Kôṭagāla of the Hôsana-nād, together with 23 hamlets (specified), and the customs dues of these villages, as well as the channel he had brought from the Lakshmaṇatîrtha near Nallûr ;—and dividing it into 125 shares, or, with the share given by Lakshmîkānta-svāmi, 126 shares, bestowed them upon Brahmans of various gôtras, sûtras and śākhas, men of all learning, worthy of favour, together with all the rights and dues (mentioned in detail as usual).

text.location: At Tarilcallu (Bilikere hobli), on a stone to the south of the Kasi-liriiga temple.
text.remarks:
While, (with usual prelude), the rājâdhirāja rāja-paramēśvara vira-pratāpa Dēva-Rāja-Vodeyar of
Maisûr, seated on the throne of Śrîraṅgapattana, was ruling the kingdom of the world in peace :—his
son Kaṇṭhirava-mahipâla (usual family descent in detail), forming in Tarriyakallu an agrahāra named
Kaṇṭhiravasamudra,—made a grant for it of the village of Tarrikallu belonging to Kôṭagāla of the
Hôsana-nād, together with 23 hamlets (specified), and the customs dues of these villages, as well as
the channel he had brought from the Lakshmaṇatîrtha near Nallûr ;—and dividing it into 125 shares,
or, with the share given by Lakshmîkānta-svāmi, 126 shares, bestowed them upon Brahmans of various
gôtras, sûtras and śākhas, men of all learning, worthy of favour, together with all the rights and dues
(mentioned in detail as usual).Read more (1 KB)

ಗಾಳಕ್ಕಿ ಸಲವತರಕಳಗ್ಗಾಮುಂ ° ಕಉಗ್ತಾಮಕ್ಕೆ ಸಲುವಲಗಗ್ಭಾಮುಂಗಳು^^14ಪ್ಪಿ ಸದರಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಕಂಬಮುದ್ದನಸಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಮುಮ್ಮಲಉಪರದರಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಬಸವನಹಳ್ಳಿ ಗ್ರಾಮಂ °^^15ಕುಲ್ಯುವಾಚಿಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ತಣ್ಣಸಮುದ್ರಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಲೋಕೈಗ್ನಾಮುಂ ° ಕುಡಿನಿರಸಮುದ್ರಪಳ್ಳಿಗ್ರಾಮುಂ °^^16ಗಾಹಾನಹಳ್ಳಿಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಉಲುಯಿಗಂಡನಪಳ್ಳಿಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಮುುಸುಕೇರಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ನಂಡೀಕುಪ್ಪಗ್ರಾಮುಂ °^^17ಲ್ಲೇವಾಸಹಳ್ಳಿಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಚಿಟ್ಟಿನಕರ್ರ್ಯಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಹೊಸಹಳ್ಳಿಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ವಠ್ಠರಗಾಸಿಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಪಟ್ಟಲಪು^^18ರಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಮೂಡಹವಮಗ್ಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ದಾಸನಹಳ್ಳಿಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಲಿಂಗನಪುರುಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ನಾಡಹನ್ನಳ್ಳು^^19ಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ದೇವಲಾಪುರಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ° ಇಲುಯುತ್ಪರಥಲುಕುಗ್ರಾಮಗಳುಸವನಾಗ್ರಾಮುಂ ೪ ಯಿಸ್ಪತ್ಮೂ^^20ಜ್ಯೂರುಗ್ರಾಮುಂಮುಳಸ್ಥ ರಧದುಸುಕಣ್ಣಉರಬಯಿಲಯುಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಮಾನಾಳ್ಯದದಕ್ಷಿಣದಅಂತಿನಕೊಟ್ಟಕಟ್ಟುಹಾಲು^^21ವೇಸವನಾಡಿ ೪೧೧೩ ನೇಜಯಿಸ್ಪತ್ತ್ಯೆಲ್‌ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಮಿಕಾಂತಸ್ವಾಮಿಗೆಮಾವಜಂಗಲವು^^22ಕ್ಟೊಟ್ಟಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿ ೧ ಉಘಧಯಂ ೬೧. ನೋಜಯಿಸ್ಪತ್ಯೆ ಜಲ್ಲುತ್ರಿ ಗಲಾಕಜಿರಕ್ಕೀದಳವರಮೂಡಿಕಣೀರವಸ^^23ಮುದ್ರಮುಂಬಲಅಧಿಪಾನವಂವರ್ಷಡಿನಾನಗೋತ್ರದವನಾನಸತ್ಯದದನನಾಶವರ್ಗೆಲವಸಕ^^24ಲವಿದ್ಯಾಪಾಲೇಲರನಪವತ್ಥತ್ಯುಂತರದವಾಕ್ಯಸ್ಯ ಗೋತ್ಯು ಪುಂಗಲಿಯಿನಾದಸಲ್ಲುಸಹಿರಣ್ಯಪಾದಕದಾನಧಾರಾ^^25ಪ್ಪೂವೃತ್ಪಕಪಾವಿನಮಗಲಪ್ಥ ೪ಸಿರಾಯುಣೇಉಸುಪುಸನನಾಗಲಿಯೊದುಕ್ಕಪವ್ಯಸ್ತಸ್ವನಬುತ್ತಿ ಯಿಂದಸ^^26ವೃಕ್ಷಮನ್ಯುವಾದಿಗಿರುರೆಯನೆಮಯೇಕ್ಟೋಟಿವಾಗಿಲ್ಲಿಯವಮುಂದೆಯೋಭಾಗಮುಗಾಲಳಸಿನಿನೆಪೂಜಲ^^27ಪೂಪಾಣಅಳಸಿನಿಗಾಲಾಮಿಷದ್ದ ಸಭ್ಯಗಳೇಕಂಬಲಸ್ವಸ್ಥಿಭೋಗೇತಜಾಸ್ಯವ್ಯಂಗಗಳನುಸವಭವಿಸಿ^^28ಕೋಂಡುನಿಸ್ಪನ್ನಿಸ್ತ್ರಮವಾಡೆಅಧಿಕೃತ್ಯಉದಾನದರಿದ್ರಣಾ ನಳಕಲವವ್ಯವಹಾರಃಉತತ್ಥಪ್ಪುಯಕ್ಕಾ ಸಲ^^29ಪಡುಯೆಂದುದುಕೆಕಚ್ಚಿ ವಾಡಕಾರಾಣಿಪ್ರೀನಿಪ್ರಿಯಪುತ್ರರೈತರವರದವರೆಯುಆಳೇಧರ್ರೈ || ಸ್ಯಾಯುಗ^^30ಲಗ್ಗಿ ಸತ್ವವ್ಯವ್ಯನಾಸ್ವಗನಿಸುಬಿನಉಭವಿಶಂಬೋಜುತುಬರಿಯಿಯೊದುರಸೀಳುತ್ತೆತಜಿಕಳಗ್ಗಿಪ್ರತಿ^^31ನ್ನಮನೃಪಾಯವದಚೀರಲ್‌ವರಸಮುದ್ರಪೇಂಬಲಆಹಾರದರಳಾಸನಸನ || ನೀಲ್ಯೋತ್ತ್ಯನೋಭಪವತ್ತೇಷಾಂ^^32ನೀತ್ಯಸ್ತನೀತ್ಯಂಗಮಲಂಗಂಯಿವೇಂಪುದೀಸೈಣ್ಯಭಾಗಗಾನಮುಗಳಾಯುತನಾಹಪಂ || ಯೋಕ್ಷೃವಭಷಿನೀಲೋಽ^^33ಕ್ಜ್ರಾಕ್ಷೃತ್ಪಾಣ್‌ಪಣಮೇವಧುಭುಂಜಾಂನಂಹಂಚಿನಯಾತ್ಕರಕ್ಕಾಗಣ್ಯವಿದ್ಯಾವ್ರತಾ ಪಸುಂಧರಾ || ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾಂಪರದತ್ತಾಂವಾಎಮಾಯೋಹ^^34ಪರೇಚಿತಿಪಸುಂಧರಾಂಪಾಪಿಸಿಮೃತ್ಯಪಾಸೇಷ್ನಿವಿಷಂಯಥಾಜಾಅಯಾಯಾತೇಶಂ || ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾ ದ್ವಗುಣಂಪುಣ್ಯಂಪರದತ್ತಾನು^^35ಪುಣ್ಯಲಹರಪದತ್ತಾಹರತ್ಥಹಾರೇಣಸ್ಯದತ್ತಾ ಇಂಶುಲಂವಪೇಷ್ಠಾ || ದನವಲನಾಸನಯೋಮ್ಯದೈಯೋಣುಸಪಾಲನದಾನಾತ್ಯೇವ^^36ಗ್ಗಾಮವದ್ಮಸ್ಯ ತ್ರಿಶೂಲನಾದಜ್ಯತೆಪದಂ || ೪ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ

cells.remarks: Mariyam-Setti, son of Singa-Setti of Malalavadi, had the temple of the god Tirumala of Tarikala-kamba repaired.
cells.text_roman:
S'rīr astu Sarvvadhāri-saṁvatsarada Kārttika-śudha 5 lu Taṟikala kambada Tirumuḷa-dēvara guḍiyanu
Malalovadiya Sīṅga-Seṭṭiyara makkalu Mariyam-Sātravaru jīrṇa-uddhārava māḍidā-nū a-seṭṭara maga
Kāḍa-Seṭṭuru Kempi-Seṭṭuru
cells.text_original:
ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಹನುಮಂತರಾಯನ ಗುಡಿಯ ಹಿಂದೆ ನೆಟ್ಟ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.

3ತಿರುಮಾಲ ದೇವರಿಗೆ ಗುಡಿಯ ನೂದು

cells.location: At Sōnahalli (Bilikere hobli), on a viragal lying near the south waste-weir of Sūlekere tank.
cells.remarks: While Viņṇuvadda Narasinga-Deva was ruling the kingdom of the world :- Changāluva having harried the cows of Baṇṇagavādi, Kūruvañcha Muda-Gavuṇḍa, Chaka-Ganda and Maği-Ganda stopped them and all three fell in the boundary of Baṇṇagavādi.
cells.text_roman:
Sosti śrī Viṣhṇuvadda-Nārasiṁha-Dēvaru pritivi-rājara ge[ya]lu Cāṅgaluva Bannagavadiya iriddu
turu hariyalu Kuruvaṁcha-Muda-Gayuṁdam Chaka-Gauṁdam Madi-Gauṁda tade mūvaru biddaru
Bannagavadiya gaḍagalu
cells.text_original:
ಹೂಣಸೂರು ತಾಲೂಕು,
ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಹನುಮಂತರಾಯನ ಗುಡಿಯ ಹಿಂದೆ ನೆಟ್ಟ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ತಿಪ್ಪೂರುಗುಡ್ಡೆ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ತುಂಡದ ಹೊಳ್ಳದಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಟ್ಟ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಸೋಣಹಳ್ಳಿ ಸೂಳಿಕೆರೆ ದಕ್ಷಿಣಕೋಡಿ ಬಳ ಕಬ್ಬೈಯಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿರುವ ವೀರಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 5′ 6″ × 3′ 3″.

text.text_original: ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಹೊಸಹೊಳಲು ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾರ್ಶ್ವನಾಥ ಬಸ್ತಿ ಗೆ ದಕ್ಷಿಣ.ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 5' × 2' 3".1 [ಶ್ರೀಪವತ್ತ್ರ]ರಮಗಂಭೀರಸ್ಯಾದ್ವಾಮೋಘಲಂಘನಂ | ಜೀವಾತ್ತ್ರೈಲೋಕ್ಯ2 ನಾಥಸ್ಯಾನಸಂಜಿ೯ನಿಸಾಸನಂ ||3 [ಭದ್ರಮಸ್ತು ಜನಕ]ಸನಾಯು | ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಸಮಧಿಗತಪಂಚಮಹಾಶಬ್ದ ಮಹಾ4 [ಮಂಡಳೇಶ್ವರ ದ್ವಾರ]ವತಿಪುರವರಾಧೀಶ್ವರಯಾದವಕುಲೊರದ್ಯ5 [ಮಣಿಸಂಯು]ಕ್ತ ವ್ಯೂಢಡವಾಣಿ ಮಲೈಪರುಳಗೇ[ತಾವದ್ವ]ಣೇಕ6 [ನಾವಾಳಂ]ಕೃತ . . . . . . . ತ್ರಿಭುವನಮಲ್ಲತಳಕಾಡುಗೋ7 [ಣ್ಣ ಭುಜ]ಬಲಿವೀ[ರಗಂಗ ಹೋ]ಸಳದೇವಪ್ರಭುವಿನರಾಜ್ಯಮುಕರೇ8 [ತ್ತರ ರಾಭಿ]ವೃದ್ಧಿ ಪ್ರವರ್ದ್ಧಮಾನಚಂದ್ರುಕ್ಕಾತರಾಂಬರಂಗೆಸಲ್ಲುತ್ತಿ9 [ಪುಡಗಂಗನಾಡಿ]ಕೊಂಭತ್ತ ನೂಸಾಸಿರಮನೇ ಕಭತ್ರಉಪಾದಿ10 [ಪ್ರಥ್ವೀರಾ]ಜ್ಯಂಗಯುತ್ತಿ ರಲುತತ್ಪಾದಪದ್ಮ[ರಾಜವಿ || ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಸಮಕೃಷ್ಣರಾಜಪೇಟೆ ತಾಲೂಕು. 277$^{11}$ಸ್ವಭುವನವಿಕೃತಾಬ್ಜಸಂಜೆತಪವಿರಾಕಾಸನಲಬ್ಧ ನೇಕಗುಣಗಳಲಂಕೃತ$^{12}$ಸತ್ಯಸಾಚಾಪ್ರಾಚಾರಚಾರುಚಾರಿತ್ರ್ಯನಿರ್ಮಲಾಂಶುಮತ್ಪ್ರತಿಪಾಲನಸುಧಗ್ಗು$^{13}$ಜ್ಞೆಧ್ವಜವಿರಾಜಿತಬಲರಂಸಹಸ್ರನೋತ್ತುಂಗಜಲಧರಕಾಮಸಹಸ್ರ$^{14}$ಭೀಮವಂದಿಸಾನನಾಥಬುಧಜನಕಲ್ಪವೃಕ್ಷವಮಸ್ಯ ತಪ್ರದಾನವ್ಯತೀತಿಯು$^{15}$ನಾಮವಧೇದೇಹೋರಸಮುದ್ರಪುತ್ರಕೀತ್ಸಸ್ವಾಮಿಪೂಜ್ಯಳಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿಯ$^{16}$ರಾಡನೆಸೂಂಬಿಸೆಸ್ಮಿತ್ರೀಶ್ರುಭಕತ್ವಸದ್ವಿದ್ಯಾದೇವರ್ಗಸ್ತನಪ್ರಭುವಿನ$^{17}$ಮನುಣೋನಯನವಲ್ಲಭಜಿನಗಂಧೋದಕವಿಕೃತ್ಯಕೋತ್ರವಾರ್ಗೆಯೂಂಡಾ$^{18}$ರಂಘುಭಯೃಷ್ಪಪ್ಯಾಕಸ್ವಾ| ದಾನವಿವಿನೋದೆಯರುಮಪ್ಪಪೇಣಿಕವಸತ್ತ್ಯಾ$^{19}$ತ್ರಿಯಮುವಿನೀವೆವರು || ೨|| || ಮರುನಿರತಮುವ್ ಜೋಗಪವಂತೆಜಾುನುನೆಸತ್ತಿ . . . .$^{20}$ಸ್ಥಳವನು .$^{21}$ . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ನೋಳವಿನಿಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯು || ೫ || . . . . . . . . .$^{22}$ . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ದೇವಪಾಂಬಿಕೆಯ || ೬|| ಉತ್ತ್ರಮನೆನೆಸಳ್ಜನಂ. . . . .$^{23}$ . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ನೆ || ಅಪ್ಪ ಓಂಸಾಸಣಿನಾಮಣೆಯ್ಯ .$^{24}$ . . . . . . . . . . . . ದೇವಿಕಪ್ಫೆಯುಂತಿ ಕುಂಬೆಜನಾಲಯಮುವಂವಸೀಸ್ತ್ರಿ ಮೂಲಸಂಗದದೇ$^{25}$ಸಿಗಣದಪಜೈನ್ಯ ಸ್ಟಾಳನದೊಳೆಕೊಂಡಕೊಂಡಾವನ್ಯಯಮೂತ್ರಿಕಾಶುಲೊಸಾಸನಲಧಾರಿದೇವತಿ$^{26}$ಪುಣ್ಯವತ್ಯಮ್ಮಗುರುಗಳನುಪ್ರಶಾಂತರೂಪಸಿದ್ಧಾನ್ಯದೇವಗೆಳ್ಯಕಳವ್ಯಪ್ರಸನ್ನಿಳಸನಿಗಳಹನ$^{27}$ಹಕ್ಕೆಯುಮಂಬಿನದರಿಯುಬಹಗಳಂಸಕೆಂಕಲಂಗವಸ್ತ್ರಮಲರೆದರಿಗೆಮಿಮೋದಕಚಿತಿಪವಂ$^{28}$ಪುರದೆಕರಿಯುಮುವಂಮರನರಮುವನಾದನನಾಸಲೆಯುಮನೆದುಮುವಂಎರಹಗಣನಾಮೂಂ$^{29}$ಎರಡುತೆಂಣೀತಿಯುಂ . . ಉಬೆಜ್ಜಣಿಯಾಯಕಮಗಣ್ಯನಾರಾಯಣಸೆಟ್ಟಿಕತ್ತಳಾಭಿತ್ಯದಭೂಮಿ$^{30}$ಯೋಳಗೆಣಿಕಷಿಯಸನಿವಾಪದಕಡವದಕೋಳದಕೇ ಜಿಎರಡುಮೂಳಕಿಕಳಿಯು$^{31}$ಮೂಢಣಕೋಳದಿಯಿಂಗರದವಳ್ಳದಿಂದಿತೆಂಕಲುಪಸುವಾಲಗದ್ದೆ | ಜರದ್ಧ ಲೆಯುಮಂ$^{32}$ಬೆಟ್ಟಿನನ್ನನಿಕತಮಂ . . ಕುಳುಹದಯ್ಯಸಿದ್ಧನ್ಯದೇವಗೆ ರಾಧಾಚಾರ್ಮ್ಯಕಳಮಣಿಕದಿಸಮ್ವರ್ಗನವಶ್ಯವಾಗಿ$^{33}$ನೋಳಬಿನಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯವರಕುಕೊಟ್ಟು . . . . ಶ್ರೀಮೂಲಸಂಗದಪೂಜನಾಗೆಧವಗೇ$^{34}$ಲ್ಲಲುನವ್ಯಮಿಯಿಲ್ಲ ಅಸ್ತಿ (ಧನ್ಯವಕ್ಷಪ)ತಿಮಲನಿದವೆಗೆ ರಮರಸಾಸಿಕರುಪತ್ರೇದೊಳಲ್ಳೋ$^{35}$ಬಿಕಫುಲಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂಬುಸ್ಥಗ್ಗೆ ತಾತಪೂಜದಣಿಗೆ ಗಾದವನಾದಿಧಫಲಕನ್ಯ ಅಥಪ್ಯಾವಂ$^{36}$ಕೊಳಿಸಿದವಗೆ . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ಸ್ವದರತ್ತಾಂಶರ .

ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಕೋಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೀಭದ್ರದೇವಾಲಯದ ದಕ್ಷಿಣಕಡೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿರುವ ವೀಕಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.

$^{3}$ಸುಂದಾನಿರೆಗಣನುಜಿತೇಜ್ಞಾನಸಂವತ್ಸರದೆ . . . . . . . . . . . .

(ಮುಂದೆ ೦೦ ಪೀಠಿಗಳು ಕಾಣುವುದಿಲ್ಲ)

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಅಗ್ರಹಾರ ಬೂಚಹಳ್ಳಿ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಮಣಿಕೇಶ್ವರದೇವಾಲಯದ ನೈರುತ್ಯುಮಂಟಪದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ವೀರಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
^ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಮಸ್ತಮಹಾಮುಂಡಳೇಶ್ವರಕಾಡಕುಂಗುಣಿಗಲಿಗಂಮಾಡಿನೋಂಟವಾದಿನೆಹವಿನೂಂಗಲುವಿನಸಗೊಂಢ
ಧುಜವಲುವಿರಗಂಸಹಾಯಸೂರ್
^ರಗನಿನಾರಿದ್ಧಿಗಿರಿದುಗ್ಗಗ್ಗಳಮ್ಲಕದಂಡಕರಾವನ್ನಿಸ್ಕಂಪ್ರತಾಪಹರ್ಕಸನ್ನಿವಿರಬಲ್ಲಲ ಚಳೇವರಪ್ರಜರಾಜಧಿನಿಸೇಯೋಸಮಮು
ದೃದ್ವಧಿಪಿನಲು
^ಸುಖಸಂಕಥಾವಿನೋದೆದಿಸಿಪ್ರಿಜ್ಯರಾಣ್ಯಂಗಯುಕ್ತಥವಿರತಪ್ಪಿಪದಪೇಕ್ಷ್ರಜಿಜೀವಿ || ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಮಸ್ತ ಪ್ರಭುಭುವನಿನಿಯಪಾರಮೂ
ಕಲಿಕಾಲದವಸ್ತೃರಾಜಕ್ಯಬ್ಯನಾಜಾ
^ಳುವೆದವಸ್ತೃ ಗುನಗಣಪವನವಸ್ತೃ ಒಜಿತೆಷ್ಕ್ಯ ಯುಗಂ ದವಾರಯೂಣ್ಯಸೇತಿಯಯರು || ಜನಕಯ್ಲಿ ಗ್ರಾಂದಹೇಣರಾಮಣಅಖಿಳಗುಣಾದಾರಟ
ಬ್ಕಜ್ಜಿತಾಯು
^ದಂದನೂಜಃತಂಜೋ಼ರ್ಕಶೇ ಕಂಜಂದಮುಖಅಧಿಬಿಕಬಲಂಬಾಉಂಬುಕಾರಾಯರಾಯಆಯತನದುಬಟ್ಟಸಂದಿನ ಕಾರಿಕಳಲಯಜೊಓಸಳನೆ
ಟ್ಟ್ಟವಟ್ಟ್ದಿಗೂಸ್ವರ್ಚದ ವಾದಂಸಜ
^ನಜನನುಸನದ್ದುಸ್ಥಿಖೀರುಜಹಂಗಂ ||
(ಮುಂದೇ ಎಂ ಪಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ಕಾಣುವದಿಲ್ಲ)

cells.remarks: The Hoysala dynasty having acquired great renown, exalting the Yadu-race of the Lunar line,— Honneya-Nāyaka, to celebrate their victory, mounted on the head of an elephant and embraced Garuda, so that all the world praised the lineage of the Hoysala servants. The descent of (besides the usual titles) the uprooter of the Makara kingdom, the elephant to the lotus garden the Kāḍava-Rāya, death to the Sēuṇa-Rāya Rāvaṇa, the establisher of the Chōla-Rāya, spring to the creeper the Pāṇḍya-Rāya's kingdom, the niḥśaṅka-pratāpa-chakravartti Hoysala vira- Sōmēśvara-Dēva, was as follows :— On the muni saying *Strike* (*hoy*), he smote the great tiger, that Sala, and became Hoysala. The promoter of his family was Vinayāditya, whose son was Ereyanga, whose son was Vishnu, whose son was Nrisimha, whose son was Ballāḷa, whose son was Narasimga, whose son was the king Sōmēśvara. To Teluṅga he brought fear, to Sēuṇa who was trembling he brought war, what mention of other kings, who bit a straw (sign of submission) before the lion to the elephants his enemies, Tryakshaṇa to the city of his enemies, the preserver of Chōla, the king Sōmēśvara,—what kings on the earth can stand before him? The descent of the dwellers at his lotus feet, the line of Nāyaka servants, was as follows ;—a sun to the Mugila-kula, a bee imbibing the honey from the lotus feet of the Hoysala king, mahā-sāmanta, having put down conspiracies and acquired the control of all the merchants, a Nārāyaṇa to heroes, Kannadiga warrior, chief nāyaka among active nāyaks, protecter of titles, bravest of the Hoysala servants, ruler of Kabbahu-nāḍ, champion over nāyakas who oppose the rules of the ? palace, champion over nāyaks who seize and let go, champion over nāyakas who enter upon war and draw back, terrifier of the Sēuṇa army, Garuḍa-Nārāyaṇa to hostile feudatories, champion over servants who break their word, champion over servants who run about shouting, champion over servants who set store by (their own) Krishnarajapët Taluq. property or life, was Gaṇḍa-Nārāyaṇa-Seṭṭi,—to whom and Mâravve-Nayakitti was born Hoysala-Seṭṭi. To him and to Māchavve-Nayakitti was born the brave Kūreyanâya-Nâyaka ; to whom and to Mâravve- Nayakitti was born Sivaneya-Nâyakan, who, with five of his servants, fulfilled his engagement (or vow) with Ballala-Deva. Lakkheya-Nâyaka, with his wife Gangâ-Devi and three servants, fulfilled his engagement with Narasinga. In the S'aka year (specified) Kanneya-Nâyaka, with his wives Ummavve, Javanavve and Kallavve, and with ten maid servants and twenty-one man servants, six times embraced Garuda on (or from) the head of an elephant and fulfilled his engagement with Sômêśvara-Deva. Unable to withstand the attack of Garuda, the thousand-headed (Âdisesha) went below the world (to the lower regions) ; but unlike him, Kanneya-Nâyaka opposed the terrible Garuḍa, smote him, shook him and embraced the immortal one, gaining great glory, the protector of titles, the servant of king Sôma. (Further praises to the effect that) standing on one leg with his head bowed in submission, he seemed to be doing penance, while his wives Kallavve, Javanavve and Ummavve excited the astonish- ment of all wives in the world by waving the heads he had cut off as an ārati around him.

property or life, was Gaṇḍa-Nārāyaṇa-Seṭṭi,—to whom and Mâravve-Nayakitti was born Hoysala-Seṭṭi.
To him and to Māchavve-Nayakitti was born the brave Kūreyanâya-Nâyaka ; to whom and to Mâravve-
Nayakitti was born Sivaneya-Nâyakan, who, with five of his servants, fulfilled his engagement (or vow)
with Ballala-Deva. Lakkheya-Nâyaka, with his wife Gangâ-Devi and three servants, fulfilled his
engagement with Narasinga. In the S'aka year (specified) Kanneya-Nâyaka, with his wives Ummavve,
Javanavve and Kallavve, and with ten maid servants and twenty-one man servants, six times embraced
Garuda on (or from) the head of an elephant and fulfilled his engagement with Sômêśvara-Deva.

Unable to withstand the attack of Garuda, the thousand-headed (Âdisesha) went below the world
(to the lower regions) ; but unlike him, Kanneya-Nâyaka opposed the terrible Garuḍa, smote him, shook
him and embraced the immortal one, gaining great glory, the protector of titles, the servant of king
Sôma. (Further praises to the effect that) standing on one leg with his head bowed in submission,
he seemed to be doing penance, while his wives Kallavve, Javanavve and Ummavve excited the astonish-
ment of all wives in the world by waving the heads he had cut off as an ārati around him.Read more (3 KB)

cells.remarks: Saja of the Yâdava-kula smote the tiger when the muni said poy Saja, and thus became Poysala, and from him the name became that of all his line. The king of serpents, trembling at Garuḍa, left the world and took refuge in Pâtâla, thinking he would seize the jewel in his head; but Singayya with- stood him and, by his worth and energy winning the name of an able-bodied servant, embraced him (Garuda) seven times, the servant of Nrisimha. The descent of (with usual titles) the pratâpa-chakravartti the Hoysala strong-armed vîra-Nara- simha-Dêvarasa was as follows:—On the muni saying Strike!—that Saja smote the great tiger and became Poysala. The promoter of his family was Vinayâditya, whose son was Ereyanga, whose son was Vishnu, whose son was Nrisimha, whose son was Ballâla, whose son was Narasimha, whose son was the king Sômêsvara. To the ornament of the Hoysala race, Sôyi-Dêva, and to his queen Bijjala- Dêvî, was born the king Narasimha. The dwellers at his lotus feet (continues as in No. 9 above). In the S'aka year (specified) Singeya -Nayaka, the son of Kanneya-Nâyaka, with his wives Kêtavve, Honnavve and Nâchavve, and with ten maid servants and twenty man servants, on (or from) the head of an elephant six times embraced Garuḍa and fulfilled his engagement with Narasimha-Dêva.

ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಕಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ.
1 ಸಳನೆಂಬ ನಿಜಯಾದವಕಾಲದೋಳಪತಿಯಖದಮುನಿದ್ದು
2 ಲಿದಯಂಣೆಯಿಲಿಸಲೆಎನಫ್ತಿಯುದುಮದುಂಪುಯುಯಸಳಚಿವಕದವಿವಾಯ್ತ
3 ಹದ್ದುಂಪಜೋಳ || ಫಣಿರಾಜಂಗರುಡಂಗೆಬಟ್ಟುಗಾನೇಲನಂಬಿಕೆಂಜವಕಳಮಣಿಯಂ
4 ಕೊಂಡುಹದನೆಬೃಷ್ಯಕನಡಬೋಳಉಳಮಣಜಂತುರಲ್ಲೊಡ್ಯನ್ನುಬಾಸುಗಿಯೊಕಿ, ಯಿಬೆಲ್ಲಿ
5 ಸಿಂದಧಟ್ಟಿನಿಲ್ಲಾಲ್ಯಉಂಬುಪ್ಪೆಂಬಿನಂಸಿಲ್ಲಿಯೋಆಸಿಬಲಿಸಿಪ್ತಿಯ ದದಸಿಂಹನವಲಂಕ [8] ಯಂ
6 ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಸಮಸ್ತ ಭುವನಶ್ರಿಯುವಂಕಳವಿಬುಧಜನಸಂಸ್ಥೂಯಮಾನಗುಣಗಣಾಕರ್ಷಯುಂ
7 ಶ್ರೀಪ್ರಿತ್ಯಾಸ್ಪಲ್ಲಭೌಧಾರುಳೌಟರ್ಬಾಳಚೋಳಮೂರಾಜಾಭಿರಾಜಚೋಳದೇವಸ್ತತ್ಪಾದಾರಾವಿ ಪರ
8 ವಾರಧಿಕ್ಷ್ಯರೌಯಾದವಕುಳಾಸೂಂಬರಾಭ್ಯುಮಿಸೆಬಳ್ಯೋಜೋಡಜಾಮೆಯಮೂಲರಾಜಾಜಮ
9 *ಲಕೇರಳಂ *ದೇಕಸವನಕಸಣದೌಪು ತಿಖಿವಯಾತ್ರ ದೌಡ್ಯೇಹಾಂವೀರೇರಂಗದಿರಸ
10 *ನಿವಾರಸಿಧಿ ಗಿರಿಮಗ್ಯ ಕಾವಲ್ಲಸುರಮಕ್ತಿಯುನ್ನು ರಿಪಷ್ಟುವದಯುಸಿವಿಟ್ಚಳವṁಕರಾವೂ

^11ಸಂಗ್ರಾಮವಿಜಯವ್ಯಾಪಾರೀಕೃತಕರುಣಾಕರಮುನಿವಿನೀತಸುಧಾಮುಖಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮರವಮು
^12ಗರರಾಜಮಧ್ಯಮ^1ಅಲಂಕಾರೋಳರಾಯಪ್ರತಾಪವ್ಯಾಲ್ಯೋದ್ಯೋತಫೋಂಡ್ರಾರಾಜ್ಯಸಮುದ್ದರ
^13ಣಾಸಿಂಹಸಂಕಲ್ಪಕಾಪತತ್ತ್ವಜ್ಞಸತ್ಯೇಹಾದೋಷ್ಠಭುಜಬಲೈಕೈಲಾಸನವಂಶೋಪೇಪರ
^14ಸನನ್ಯಾವತಾರಾವತಂಸದೇಹವೆ || ಮುನಿಜಯವ್ಯೋದಪೇಹೋದ್ಯದಹೆಳ್ಳಯ
^15ನಾದಂತತ್ಕಲಂಪುಯಲಂವಿನಿಯದಿಯಾತ್ಯಸುತಕುಶಲಂವಿನೇತೋಪಂಗನು
^16ತತುಸುತನುವಿಷ್ಣು ತತ್ಸತೇಯಂಸುಸಿಂಹನವಗೋದಣ್ಣತಪಿಲ್ಲಾ ತೇನತನ
^17ಪುತ್ಯೊನ[ಲ]ಸಿಷ್ಯನತನಸುತನುಸೋಮೇವ್ಯಲ್ಲೋಟ್ಟಿಜ್ಞಾಕೇಶ್ವರಂ || ಮುನಿಸಿಂದ..ದಿಂಮೂ
^18ಪಿದವನಸ್ವದಹೋಮಿಗೊಹೇವಿಯಿಸಿಬಜ್ಜ ಲದೇವಿಪರಾಶಿಗೆಗೊಹೆಯ್ಯಳಕಳಿಳಕಂ
^19ಸೋeಯದೇವಿಗಂಮಬ್ಬಳೇ^ಅಳವಲಯೊಬ್ಬಚ್ಚುಬಿವಂಪ್ರಸ್ತದನಸಿಂಹಕರವ್ಯಾಧ್ಯೇತೃದ್ರವೃಕ್ಷ
^20ಸ್ಥಳಕಚಹೋಕ್ಷೇಗಾಸಿಧಾರಣಾಮವಿದಳಕನಸೋಹಂನಪಣಸಾರಂಹೊ || ತತುಸಾಪದ
^21ಪದ್ಮ್ಯೋಜಪ್ರಿಬಗಳೆಸಿನಿವ್ಯಯುವಾಗಳ . . . . ನಾಯಕರ್‌ , ಕ್ರಮವಂತಂದ
^22ಜೆ || ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಮಸ್ತು ವಿನುಗೀತಕಾಲಕ್ರಮವುತ್ತಾ ಕಂಠೌಹೊಯ್ಯಳಲ್ಲೇವರದೇವರದೆಯಿಂದ
^23ಮುಕರದವ್ರತಭೃಂಗರಕ್ತೈಮನ್ನಾ ವಾಹನಭ್ರಮರಂಚಂಸನು , . , , ಹಾನಂ
^24ಮದ್ದಿನಸಾನಾಸನಾಧೇಯಿಯೊಸಿಟ್ಟಿನೇಕ್ಕರುಮ , . , , ನಾರಾಯಣರುಂ , . . . .
ಅದರ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಕಂಬು.
(ಮುಂದೆ ೧೬ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳು ಬಿರುದುಗಳಿಗಿವೆ)
^41ಸಕಕವರುತ್ತಡ ೧೦೬೮ ನೇಯುಬಿರಸೇವತ್ಸರದಳಸ್ನಜಾಸುಬಿದಿಗೆಸೋಮವಾರವಳಲ್ಲ
^42ನಾರಲೊಂಗು ದೇವೀರಸರಕೂಡಿಕೆಂಶೆಣಯಮಾಯಕವರಮಗಂಗಿಸೋಗೆಯನಾಯಕಂಶಂ
^43ಜೊಂಜತಿಶೇಷವ್ಯಾಯನಾಯಕಿ ತಿಹೊಕೊನ್ಮವಾಯಕಿ ತಿಣಾಜಯೇನಾಯಕಿ ತಿಅಂತುಮಾವಿನಲಿಸಲಿಕಿ
^44ತಿಯುರಂಜುಪುಟ್ಟು ವಾನಿನಲೇಕಂಕುಪರಸ , . ಮಲ್ಲಿಕಅಬಬಾಗೆಗರರುದನಪ್ಪಿಬೂ
^45ಸೆಯೂಪೌರ್ವದ್ಯದನು | ಸುಪದತಪದರತ ^ ವಾಯೋಹೇಪೇತ್ರಿವಸಂಭುಧಾಪ್ರಶೃವೃಷರು
